news_mentions.headline: Arizona Cardinals training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.headline: Week 4 fantasy sleepers: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota, Panthers TE Darren Waller offer upside
news_mentions.description: Can Marcus Mariota thrive once again in relief of Jayden Daniels? Will Darren Waller go off against the Lions in prime time? Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 4.
news_mentions.body_text: pumpkin spice lattes scary movies and orange foliage as far as the eye can see they re all on the way it s october hard to believe we ve already completed a sixth of the nfl season it has been a wild first three weeks and they ve given way to a week 4 slate with some juicy matchups a potential international shootout a cat fight in cincinnati a battle for texas bragging rights and just as we all expected the showdown of unbeatens in las vegas for first place in the afc west there are plenty of fantasy points to be seized in such a schedule even from the most unlikely of places that s what the sleepers column is all about not all of us can have jahmyr gibbs jaxon smith njigba brock purdy and brock bowers on our rosters whether you re trying to stay unbeaten get back to 500 or notch that elusive first win of the season let s all have some fun and find some diamonds in the rough note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Nov. 10's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: Niners owner Jed York suspended six games, fined $500K by NFL for violating personal conduct policy
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York has been suspended for six games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy, the league announced Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: san francisco 49ers owner jed york has been suspended for six games and fined 500 000 for violating the nfl s personal conduct policy the league announced friday york who was arrested on aug 23 on misdemeanor charges of disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools has been absent from san francisco s first three games which will count toward his suspension he can return to the team following the team s week 6 monday night game against the washington commanders on oct 19 today the nfl concluded its review and i accept its decision in full york said in a statement released by the team obtained by nfl network insider mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter to my family to the players coaches and employees of the san francisco 49ers to our fans and partners i am deeply sorry this was an inexcusable mistake and i take full responsibility what i did does not reflect my values or the man i strive to be for my family while i fell short of the model i want to set for my sons i now hope to show them the importance of owning up to one s failures and that even our worst moments teach us to be better leading the 49ers is a privilege and one i don t take lightly your trust will have to be earned back over time and i look forward to that work ahead york s august arrest took place in east palestine ohio after which he was released on a 5 000 bond york was fined 1 150 and sentenced to one day in jail for his two misdemeanor offenses and was credited with time served he has since pleaded no contest to both charges york was initially charged with engaging in prostitution per court records but prosecutors changed that charge to disorderly conduct records also indicated york had a cellphone returned to him and also had 160 seized during his arrest which was to be donated to the mahoning valley human trafficking task force as part of his plea agreement york has since completed an online course as well york 46 has been in control of the 49ers day to day operations since taking them over from his parents in 2008 and became the team s principal owner in 2024 he s overseen the franchise through eight playoff trips with seven nfc championship game appearances and three trips to the super bowl

news_mentions.headline: Colts vs. Commanders: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 4 London game
news_mentions.description: Can Indianapolis star Jonathan Taylor break out of his early-season slump? Will Marcus Mariota lead Washington to a second straight win in relief of Jayden Daniels? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Colts-Commanders game in London.
news_mentions.body_text: the european leg of the nfl s 2026 world tour kicks off this weekend in the league s most familiar foreign locale after stops in oceania and south america london is the setting for sunday morning football for the next three weeks starting with this week s colts commanders clash at tottenham hotspur stadium two of the nfl s older franchises indianapolis 1953 and washington 1932 are no strangers to the new reality of annual international football in fact both teams broke ground last season on the european continent the colts played in and won the nfl s first ever game played in berlin while the commanders participated in but lost the league s first game in spain played at madrid s bernabeu both indy and d c got off the schneid last week improving to 1 2 with surprising victories over 2025 playoff teams this sunday washington will look to break another ignominious streak winning its first international game in four tries the commanders are the only nfl franchise to play in at least three international games and not have a win 0 2 1 can the capital s club capitalize on its first win of the season with another in england or will jonathan taylor and co run over the competition overseas yet again three must know storylines 1 can taylor finally break out of early season slump jonathan taylor is as reggie jackson once coined himself the straw that stirs the drink he makes indy s offense go and has done so for the past six seasons this year he s tied for the league lead in rushing attempts through three games 66 but he s off to a career worst start in terms of efficiency taylor is averaging fewer than 4 rushing yards per attempt and has yet to record 100 ground yards in a game this season plus he s coming off the worst of his three efforts a 68 yard td less game in week 3 s slim win over houston standing in his way in week 4 a washington unit that has been surprisingly stout in run defense allowing just 246 yards through three weeks third in nfl at 3 8 yards per carry the commanders are tops in the league in run stuff percentage 25 and have allowed just five runs of 10 plus yards tied for third per next gen stats taylor was a horse in the colts international outing last season posting 244 rushing yards and 286 yards from scrimmage both international records per nfl research in indy s overtime victory over atlanta at olympiastadion with 78 rushing yards against washington taylor will be the all time leading rusher in international games in nfl history as daniel jones works his way back into form and the colts deal with health issues for wideouts alec pierce keenan allen and ashton dulin taylor needs to bring that horsepower again or indy won t be able to keep pace with jacksonville in the afc south 2 commanders sans starting qb in europe again washington is playing its second international game in as many years without its star quarterback under center after jayden daniels missed last year s madrid game with a dislocated elbow the nfl scheduled the commanders for a week 4 international bout surely the 2024 offensive rookie of the year would be healthy for that lone window slot nope daniels was ruled out for the second straight game on friday after dislocating the same left elbow in week 2 the commanders qb has foregone surgery and a stint on injured reserve and was limited in practices this week in london washington coach dan quinn said daniels return to practice was a big step that ll be little solace to the english fans who were eager to get a glimpse of the star signal caller in action on sunday lucky for washington it has an ace second stringer in fellow former no 2 pick marcus mariota the flyin hawaiian arrived in the united kingdom on a high this week after posting a throwback performance in the commanders week 3 upset of the reigning super bowl champion seahawks last sunday mariota enjoyed his first three td zero int 110 0 plus passer rating game since week 8 of 2022 and salted away the victory with a clutch read option run it was vintage stuff will it translate to week 4 against a league worst colts defense 417 3 total yards per game allowed albeit one that shut down houston last week or will a second consecutive game without daniels lead to another international defeat with mariota under center 3 can receivers take advantage of struggling dbs in a matchup featuring two down defenses it s paramount for each offense to identify areas of vulnerability to attack those soft spots lie in the secondaries of both ds meaning the offenses will aim to exploit advantages with their receivers the colts will be looking to new wr1 josh downs who took up the mantle left by the injured alec pierce and departed michael pittman downs has averaged a team high 2 4 yards per route on a 32 8 target rate in weeks 2 and 3 while the colts have mostly been without pierce and ranks 15th among qualified receivers in receiving expected points added 12 6 just below justin jefferson per next gen stats indy will hope to get him in positions against mike sainristil who has allowed a league high five touchdowns and a 142 4 passer rating when targeted through three weeks his defensive back mates jeremy reaves 154 6 rating 42 8 croe and quan martin 28 croe have fared no better opening up opportunities for keenan allen barring a groin issue keeping him out and tight end tyler warren meanwhile washington will look to exploit justin walley in the slot the colts primary nickelback has allowed 13 receptions on 15 targets for 213 yards and two tds in the slot the most yards allowed by any defender and 84 more than the next closest cb opponents have recorded a perfect 158 3 passer rating when targeting walley in those matchups per next gen stats that could spell a big day for the commanders top three receivers two time pro bowler terry mclaurin who s looking for his first 100 yard game in 2026 but is questionable with a balky hamstring rookie antonio williams who boasts a team high 27 2 croe and 8 7 receiving epa when targeted in the slot and veteran stefon diggs who has run a team high 44 routes out of the slot this season

news_mentions.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels (elbow) ruled out for London game; QB Marcus Mariota to start vs. Colts
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will be a bystander in London on Sunday. Washington Commanders coach Dan Quinn ruled out Daniels for Week 4’s tilt against the Indianapolis Colts.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels will be a bystander in london on sunday washington commanders coach dan quinn ruled out daniels on friday for week 4 s tilt against the indianapolis colts marcus mariota will make his second start of the season under center for washington we ll assess where we are next week when he gets a full week of practice all the way through quinn said of daniels but typical for him working incredibly hard to get back doing everything that he can behind the scenes to go do that as fast as he can he is a true competitor on and off the field daniels dislocated his non throwing elbow in a week 2 loss to the dallas cowboys the third year pro flew across the pond with the club and was a limited participant in practices this week sporting a rather large brace on his left arm daniels dismissed any worry about reinjuring the elbow which caused him to miss significant action in 2025 however the commanders aren t yet ready to throw their starter back into the fire just yet certainly anytime you can practice that s a big deal quinn said when asked how close daniels was to returning so for him to get back that was a big step for us to see what it looked like and where it would go typical for him like he s more ready than you expect so that s just kind of how he is but we ll get the whole week for him and get back at it get his elbow his body everything back right but it was really impressive to see it mariota performed well standing in for daniels last week tossing three touchdowns with zero interceptions for a 110 0 passer rating against the super bowl champion seattle seahawks in a week 3 win it marked mariota s first three td tilt since week 8 2022 with the falcons in two games one start one relief mariota is one of four qbs with four plus pass tds and zero ints in 2026 jared goff geno smith drew lock mariota and the commanders will face a colts defense that got on track in last week s 19 17 win over the houston texans but still ranks 32nd in yards allowed 417 3 and yards per play 6 5 and 30th in pass yards per game 276 0

news_mentions.headline: Dolphins rookie OL Kadyn Proctor expects heat from Vikings DC Brian Flores: 'I am the weakest link'
news_mentions.description: Brian Flores brings the heat to every offensive lineman regardless of pedigree. Dolphins rookie guard Kadyn Proctor expects the Vikings' blitz-happy defensive coordinator to target him specifically in Sunday’s bout.
news_mentions.body_text: brian flores brings the heat to every offensive lineman regardless of pedigree dolphins rookie guard kadyn proctor expects the vikings blitz happy defensive coordinator to target him specifically in sunday s bout i would say so proctor said this week via the palm beach post you know like i say i m the weakest link and you know people have attacked me up to this point but i m not scared i m not going to shy away from it so bring it flores is on a heater to open the season carrying the vikings to a 3 0 record minnesota has the second fewest total yards 715 of any team to start 3 0 since 1970 and currently owns the worst offense statistically in the nfl ranking 32nd in total yards 238 3 passing yards per game 137 yards per play 4 3 and first downs 39 yet the vikings are undefeated entering sunday because flores has bamboozled offenses the 2026 vikings have the highest blitz rate 71 1 of any team in a season since 2016 they also have the highest pressure rate 46 7 of any team in a season since 2018 per next gen stats flores defense leads the nfl with 14 sacks making minnesota the fifth team over the last 40 seasons with four plus sacks and two plus takeaways in each of its first three games of a season others 2024 vikings 2018 bears 1993 saints 1989 washington flores defenses being on that list twice now is no coincidence proctor has been solid early in his career next to left tackle patrick paul the rookie has allowed half a sack and eight qb pressures through three games including one quick pressure per next gen stats right tackle austin jackson played under flores the former dolphins coach in 2019 the veteran knows miami s offense must be ready for whatever the vikings throw at them pressure and all yeah he does do it a lot in certain situations jackson said of flores bringing extra rushers it s really situational it s really situational i would say we study as much as we can on our end but at the end of the day he could choose not to blitz us he could drop everyone make us read you never know for sure but we re just gonna study all the blitzes we can and prepare to react to whatever we get on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Mike McDaniel takes responsibility for Chargers' poor offense in 0-3 start: 'I'm not living in hope'
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles has suffered three straight losses with fewer than 45 total points scored for the first time with Justin Herbert as starting quarterback.
news_mentions.body_text: los angeles chargers coordinator mike mcdaniel isn t shying away from responsibility for the club s lack of offensive productivity in its 0 3 start i m fully responsible he said thursday via espn i spend zero time trying to avoid blame it s quite the opposite the chargers rank 30th in expected points added per play 0 21 have scored 14 7 points per game 29th in the nfl and sit 27th in turnovers with six their 44 points through three games are the fewest by the franchise since 2003 37 finished 4 12 per nfl research l a has suffered three straight losses with fewer than 45 total points scored for the first time with justin herbert as starting quarterback in week 3 the chargers offense keyed the defeat l a became the first team to lose with fewer than 25 points allowed and a 4 turnover differential or better since 2012 cardinals lost to falcons 23 19 in week 11 the buffalo defeat was the first chargers loss with at least five takeaways and fewer than 25 points allowed since week 4 1986 we were the reason we lost the football game mcdaniel said and you gotta pull your weight in this league the offense has looked as bad as the numbers suggest nothing is fluid herbert looks uncomfortable earning a career low 73 4 passer rating 30th in the nfl ahead of only drake maye and jameis winston among 32 qualified qbs the interior of the offensive line gets blasted routinely the running game is ineffective penalties are a problem there are things we ve done in the past three games that are active participation in losing the game he said and so flat out our jobs are going to prove everything and i m not living in hope i m living in reality desperately needing a victory the chargers face the defending super bowl champion seattle seahawks who come in seething after giving up 33 points in a road loss to washington last week it s going to be loud mcdaniel said they re going to be a salty team that has lost their first game in like 12 games and you know what that s just what we need an opponent that definitely is not going to feel sorry for us

news_mentions.headline: Jared Verse: 'This ain't the old Browns'
news_mentions.description: The Cleveland Browns took over first place in the AFC North with a 27-24 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: these browns aren t those browns todd monken s football team played with ferocity and physicality thursday night beating up the pittsburgh steelers and building a 14 point first half lead after the steelers mounted a comeback deshaun watson and the offense showed moxie marching for the game winning field goal in the 27 24 victory the 3 1 browns have taken over first place in the afc north and feel decidedly different than past years this ain t the old browns defensive end jared verse said after the win we ve got new swag we re a lot more aggressive a lot more you know getting after it this is something different here we re going to make this whole city rock cleveland rocked thursday night especially in the first half when watson finally looked like the quarterback the browns traded for in 2022 the qb who was suspended 11 games in his first season in cleveland following allegations of sexual misconduct and dealt with a string of injuries including missing all of 2025 due to an achilles tear made plays with his arm and his legs watson went 14 of 17 for 181 yards and a touchdown as the browns built a 21 10 first half lead it was electric it was amazing watson said from the time we came out pregame it was super dope to be called out hear the crowd and feel the energy from start to finish the crowd was in it the energy of the stadium we fed off them to get a big victory against a divisional rival on prime time this is what you dream about this is what you work for these are the things that you put that grind in during the summertime and training camp for nights like this it was amazing the second half got choppier for watson and the offense the qb went 10 of 16 for 87 yards with an interception and a fumble in the second half however in the crucible of big moments watson escaped the pocket to pick up a big first down and made key throws to put the browns in position to kick the game winner more than a month after being booed by home fans in a preseason game and lashing out at them afterward watson delivered a game that finally earned cheers from the hometown crowd after things looked dead in the water following week 1 s blowout loss the browns are on a three game winning streak that was a complete maybe disaster is a little bit strong but that s a tough opening game in every phase other than maybe kickoff return maybe other than that but the guys trusted the process monken said we got stung a little bit and our guys responded to that and man that locker room is fun right there celebrating those guys big big big divisional win watson has led a game winning drive in each of the last three games the longest such streak of his career the only other browns quarterback to lead a game winning drive in three consecutive games was brian sipe in weeks 1 3 1979 en route to a third place finish in mvp voting the cleveland football team has had few peaks in the past two plus decades since the browns return in 1999 they ve made just three playoff appearances there have been memorable campaigns with baker mayfield helping break the postseason drought in 2020 and joe flacco helping run the browns to a playoff bid in 2023 however with the young playmakers highlighted by verse and a stingy defense along with receivers denzel boston and kc concepcion and a rejuvenated running back quinshon judkins this time feels more sustainable than those flashes in the pan monken cautioned after the win that it s only three victories and the season is long however with a relatively cushy schedule if watson keeps playing well the browns will be in the thick of things in the afc it s still only three wins the coach said and there s a lot of things we can continue to get better at and we will because our guys are humble and they re still hungry and it s really cool because it means the next one continues to matter that s all you want to be you just want to be in a position where the games matter right that s what we want to be in that s what our fans want to be in and that s what we re going to fight for every day

news_mentions.headline: Jets' Aaron Glenn looking forward to facing Ben Johnson, Bears: 'He's a damn good coach'
news_mentions.description: Jets HC Aaron Glenn is set to face a familiar foe for the second straight week when his team takes on Ben Johnson's Bears.
news_mentions.body_text: aaron glenn is on an unintentional reunion tour in weeks 3 and 4 the former lions defensive coordinator returned to detroit with his new york jets last week falling 31 24 to dan campbell and co this sunday glenn s jets will face former lions offensive coordinator ben johnson s chicago bears whom glenn knows quite well from their many practices spent battling against each other in detroit we were so competitive in move the ball situations on how we wanted to beat each other but it made both of us better i will say that glenn said wednesday about going up against johnson during lions practices via the jets official site he s a damn good coach those practices were famously competitive the 2022 season of hbo s hard knocks featured the lions which meant the up close look at the up and coming team would undoubtedly include some footage of these sessions and glenn and running backs coach duce staley didn t disappoint in their trash talk given how the lions transformed into a perennial contender in the ensuing seasons it s no surprise campbell s lieutenants have taken top jobs elsewhere one of these two is a step ahead of the other as of now though johnson has a 2025 division title and playoff win on his resume as bears coach while glenn is still working toward transforming the jets when you have coordinators offensive and defensive coordinators you re really planning practice glenn said you re really planning the things you want to see against each other so the communication between me and him was always outstanding just talking offensive and defensive football was good to have this portion of the jets 2026 schedule is either a coincidence or a cruel joke the connections don t stop here either new york faces the cleveland browns for whom staley serves as running backs coach in week 5 it s also serving as a quality test of glenn s jets and where they stand in their second year under his direction observers will note new york has played much more competitively through three weeks than they did at almost any point in the 2025 season and if glenn needed his own measuring stick he s receiving two in consecutive weeks he ll have his hands full this week johnson s bears aren t expected to have budding star quarterback caleb williams available due to a hamstring injury suffered in week 2 but after 38 year old third stringer case keenum carved up the philadelphia eagles on monday night glenn s jets might have to prepare for any of chicago s three quarterbacks adding more work to his plate glenn isn t going to back down though much like the heated sessions on the practice fields in michigan he ll bring his full effort primarily because he knows it s required johnson has those guys playing really really well glenn said we re looking forward to having a good week of practice and getting ready to go compete against a really good team our guys will be ready to do that

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker, 49ers QB Brock Purdy highlight September Players of the Month
news_mentions.description: San Francisco quarterback Brock Purdy and Kansas City running back Kenneth Walker are among those honored in with Player of the Month accolades.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in september each month the league unveils its honor roll see who the players of the month are below afc offensive player of the month the chiefs ballyhooed free agent addition has paid immediate dividends walker blasted off with 173 rushing yards and three total touchdowns in the chiefs season opening win as kansas city has raced to a 3 0 start walker s been the offense s motor posting four scrimmage touchdowns two receiving two rushing and heads into october as the nfl s leading rusher with 360 yards nfc offensive player of the month through three games and three victories purdy has been nearly flawless purdy has sparkled to the tune of 60 of 83 passing 72 3 for 789 yards and nine touchdowns with just one interception he s also rushed for 93 yards eight first downs and a touchdown on 10 carries the 49ers 3 0 are undefeated and purdy is atop the nfl in touchdown passes tied for first and passer rating 133 1 and has yet to take a sack afc defensive player of the month every bills game so far has ended with a buffalo victory and rousseau recording two sacks rousseau has piled up 15 tackles an nfl leading eight tackles for loss three forced fumbles and a league leading six sacks which are just two off his career high for a season nfc defensive player of the month the giants are tied for first in the nfc east and holland has been a huge reason why his three interceptions are tied for the nfl lead and he s had one in each game along with a pair of forced fumbles 12 tackles and four pass breakups throw in a fumble recovery and holland s four takeaways are an nfl best afc special teams player of the month it was a perfect september for mcpherson the bengals big boot has converted each of his eight extra points and all of his eight field goal tries among those eight fgs mcpherson has made an nfl high five from 50 plus nfc special teams player of the month a day after hauling in nfc special teams player of the week price is right back for monthly honors after all he leads the nfl with 353 kick return yards and likewise leads the league with 130 punt return yards on sunday he turned in an 86 yard punt return for a touchdown thus far the only pr td in the nfl this year offensive rookie of the month what a story benson is penning through three nfl games the undrafted free agent has started each game for an undefeated chiefs squad and has now become the first lineman to win offensive rookie of the month since the colts quenton nelson in october 2018 the accolade is richly deserved benson who amazingly never played left tackle in college at indiana has allowed just seven qb pressures and one sack on 106 pass blocks 6 6 pressure rate 0 9 sack rate defensive rookie of the month in a crowded pool of defensive rookie standouts such as the commanders sonny styles and the raiders hezekiah masses the nfl s leading tackler has garnered recognition hill also has a pair of pass breakups in his three starts and has quickly developed a reputation as being a sure tackler his 5 6 missed tackle rate is seventh lowest among qualified off ball linebackers and his 12 run stops are fifth at his position per next gen stats
