news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will be a bystander in London on Sunday. Washington Commanders coach Dan Quinn ruled out Daniels for Week 4’s tilt against the Indianapolis Colts.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels will be a bystander in london on sunday washington commanders coach dan quinn ruled out daniels on friday for week 4 s tilt against the indianapolis colts marcus mariota will make his second start of the season under center for washington we ll assess where we are next week when he gets a full week of practice all the way through quinn said of daniels but typical for him working incredibly hard to get back doing everything that he can behind the scenes to go do that as fast as he can he is a true competitor on and off the field daniels dislocated his non throwing elbow in a week 2 loss to the dallas cowboys the third year pro flew across the pond with the club and was a limited participant in practices this week sporting a rather large brace on his left arm daniels dismissed any worry about reinjuring the elbow which caused him to miss significant action in 2025 however the commanders aren t yet ready to throw their starter back into the fire just yet certainly anytime you can practice that s a big deal quinn said when asked how close daniels was to returning so for him to get back that was a big step for us to see what it looked like and where it would go typical for him like he s more ready than you expect so that s just kind of how he is but we ll get the whole week for him and get back at it get his elbow his body everything back right but it was really impressive to see it mariota performed well standing in for daniels last week tossing three touchdowns with zero interceptions for a 110 0 passer rating against the super bowl champion seattle seahawks in a week 3 win it marked mariota s first three td tilt since week 8 2022 with the falcons in two games one start one relief mariota is one of four qbs with four plus pass tds and zero ints in 2026 jared goff geno smith drew lock mariota and the commanders will face a colts defense that got on track in last week s 19 17 win over the houston texans but still ranks 32nd in yards allowed 417 3 and yards per play 6 5 and 30th in pass yards per game 276 0

news_mentions.headline: Dolphins rookie OL Kadyn Proctor expects heat from Vikings DC Brian Flores: 'I am the weakest link'
news_mentions.description: Brian Flores brings the heat to every offensive lineman regardless of pedigree. Dolphins rookie guard Kadyn Proctor expects the Vikings' blitz-happy defensive coordinator to target him specifically in Sunday’s bout.
news_mentions.body_text: brian flores brings the heat to every offensive lineman regardless of pedigree dolphins rookie guard kadyn proctor expects the vikings blitz happy defensive coordinator to target him specifically in sunday s bout i would say so proctor said this week via the palm beach post you know like i say i m the weakest link and you know people have attacked me up to this point but i m not scared i m not going to shy away from it so bring it flores is on a heater to open the season carrying the vikings to a 3 0 record minnesota has the second fewest total yards 715 of any team to start 3 0 since 1970 and currently owns the worst offense statistically in the nfl ranking 32nd in total yards 238 3 passing yards per game 137 yards per play 4 3 and first downs 39 yet the vikings are undefeated entering sunday because flores has bamboozled offenses the 2026 vikings have the highest blitz rate 71 1 of any team in a season since 2016 they also have the highest pressure rate 46 7 of any team in a season since 2018 per next gen stats flores defense leads the nfl with 14 sacks making minnesota the fifth team over the last 40 seasons with four plus sacks and two plus takeaways in each of its first three games of a season others 2024 vikings 2018 bears 1993 saints 1989 washington flores defenses being on that list twice now is no coincidence proctor has been solid early in his career next to left tackle patrick paul the rookie has allowed half a sack and eight qb pressures through three games including one quick pressure per next gen stats right tackle austin jackson played under flores the former dolphins coach in 2019 the veteran knows miami s offense must be ready for whatever the vikings throw at them pressure and all yeah he does do it a lot in certain situations jackson said of flores bringing extra rushers it s really situational it s really situational i would say we study as much as we can on our end but at the end of the day he could choose not to blitz us he could drop everyone make us read you never know for sure but we re just gonna study all the blitzes we can and prepare to react to whatever we get on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Mike McDaniel takes responsibility for Chargers' poor offense in 0-3 start: 'I'm not living in hope'
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles has suffered three straight losses with fewer than 45 total points scored for the first time with Justin Herbert as starting quarterback.
news_mentions.body_text: los angeles chargers coordinator mike mcdaniel isn t shying away from responsibility for the club s lack of offensive productivity in its 0 3 start i m fully responsible he said thursday via espn i spend zero time trying to avoid blame it s quite the opposite the chargers rank 30th in expected points added per play 0 21 have scored 14 7 points per game 29th in the nfl and sit 27th in turnovers with six their 44 points through three games are the fewest by the franchise since 2003 37 finished 4 12 per nfl research l a has suffered three straight losses with fewer than 45 total points scored for the first time with justin herbert as starting quarterback in week 3 the chargers offense keyed the defeat l a became the first team to lose with fewer than 25 points allowed and a 4 turnover differential or better since 2012 cardinals lost to falcons 23 19 in week 11 the buffalo defeat was the first chargers loss with at least five takeaways and fewer than 25 points allowed since week 4 1986 we were the reason we lost the football game mcdaniel said and you gotta pull your weight in this league the offense has looked as bad as the numbers suggest nothing is fluid herbert looks uncomfortable earning a career low 73 4 passer rating 30th in the nfl ahead of only drake maye and jameis winston among 32 qualified qbs the interior of the offensive line gets blasted routinely the running game is ineffective penalties are a problem there are things we ve done in the past three games that are active participation in losing the game he said and so flat out our jobs are going to prove everything and i m not living in hope i m living in reality desperately needing a victory the chargers face the defending super bowl champion seattle seahawks who come in seething after giving up 33 points in a road loss to washington last week it s going to be loud mcdaniel said they re going to be a salty team that has lost their first game in like 12 games and you know what that s just what we need an opponent that definitely is not going to feel sorry for us

news_mentions.headline: Jared Verse: 'This ain't the old Browns'
news_mentions.description: The Cleveland Browns took over first place in the AFC North with a 27-24 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: these browns aren t those browns todd monken s football team played with ferocity and physicality thursday night beating up the pittsburgh steelers and building a 14 point first half lead after the steelers mounted a comeback deshaun watson and the offense showed moxie marching for the game winning field goal in the 27 24 victory the 3 1 browns have taken over first place in the afc north and feel decidedly different than past years this ain t the old browns defensive end jared verse said after the win we ve got new swag we re a lot more aggressive a lot more you know getting after it this is something different here we re going to make this whole city rock cleveland rocked thursday night especially in the first half when watson finally looked like the quarterback the browns traded for in 2022 the qb who was suspended 11 games in his first season in cleveland following allegations of sexual misconduct and dealt with a string of injuries including missing all of 2025 due to an achilles tear made plays with his arm and his legs watson went 14 of 17 for 181 yards and a touchdown as the browns built a 21 10 first half lead it was electric it was amazing watson said from the time we came out pregame it was super dope to be called out hear the crowd and feel the energy from start to finish the crowd was in it the energy of the stadium we fed off them to get a big victory against a divisional rival on prime time this is what you dream about this is what you work for these are the things that you put that grind in during the summertime and training camp for nights like this it was amazing the second half got choppier for watson and the offense the qb went 10 of 16 for 87 yards with an interception and a fumble in the second half however in the crucible of big moments watson escaped the pocket to pick up a big first down and made key throws to put the browns in position to kick the game winner more than a month after being booed by home fans in a preseason game and lashing out at them afterward watson delivered a game that finally earned cheers from the hometown crowd after things looked dead in the water following week 1 s blowout loss the browns are on a three game winning streak that was a complete maybe disaster is a little bit strong but that s a tough opening game in every phase other than maybe kickoff return maybe other than that but the guys trusted the process monken said we got stung a little bit and our guys responded to that and man that locker room is fun right there celebrating those guys big big big divisional win watson has led a game winning drive in each of the last three games the longest such streak of his career the only other browns quarterback to lead a game winning drive in three consecutive games was brian sipe in weeks 1 3 1979 en route to a third place finish in mvp voting the cleveland football team has had few peaks in the past two plus decades since the browns return in 1999 they ve made just three playoff appearances there have been memorable campaigns with baker mayfield helping break the postseason drought in 2020 and joe flacco helping run the browns to a playoff bid in 2023 however with the young playmakers highlighted by verse and a stingy defense along with receivers denzel boston and kc concepcion and a rejuvenated running back quinshon judkins this time feels more sustainable than those flashes in the pan monken cautioned after the win that it s only three victories and the season is long however with a relatively cushy schedule if watson keeps playing well the browns will be in the thick of things in the afc it s still only three wins the coach said and there s a lot of things we can continue to get better at and we will because our guys are humble and they re still hungry and it s really cool because it means the next one continues to matter that s all you want to be you just want to be in a position where the games matter right that s what we want to be in that s what our fans want to be in and that s what we re going to fight for every day

news_mentions.headline: Steelers-Browns on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Cleveland's 27-24 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down the top takeaways from the Cleveland Browns' 27-24 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers on Thursday night.
news_mentions.body_text: watson has browns in first place like him or loathe him deshaun watson led the browns to a result that their fans had to love on thursday night looking like the best version of himself since his days with the texans for much of the evening and struggling plenty too watson piloted cleveland on a game winning drive that ended with a 56 yard andre szmyt field goal moments later grant delpit sealed the win and a banner day for the browns defense with an interception when he was at his best watson was decisive and accurate finishing 24 of 33 passing for 268 yards with a 2 yard touchdown pass to harold fannin watson and co sputtered at the onset back to back punts on seven plays and stumbled a bit at the end interceptions and two fumbles one lost in second half the end result and the impressive play in between are the largest takeaways though joining brian sipe 1979 watson became just the second quarterback to lead game winning drives in the fourth quarter of three straight browns games entering the night the browns steelers bengals and ravens were tied for first regardless of the results for the latter two on sunday cleveland will end week 4 in first place the last time the browns ended a game week leading the afc north was when they were 1 0 in 2023 led by watson these browns are in first place after four games who would ve thunk it steelers lose in ugly fashion a methodical start and a frenetic finish weren t enough to erase the ugliness in between for aaron rodgers and the steelers offense grumpy most of the night as he was battered by the browns pass rush rodgers threw for 299 yards and three touchdowns before his second interception ended the game it was dramatic in the end and showed off some fight from the steelers but this wasn t a pretty loss for pittsburgh it was bowling shoe ugly mostly rodgers was sacked five times with cleveland racking up 10 qb hits with the browns readily applying man coverage 73 3 of the time and steelers receivers unable to find separation pittsburgh failed to scheme options open and rodgers rarely dumped it to a short and easy option instead he took too many sacks got upset and often vented his frustrations much of the talk is likely to be video capturing a frustrated rodgers cussing about a play not getting in fast enough and head coach mike mccarthy returning his quarterback s choice words rodgers guided the steelers on a 15 play sojourn that covered 78 yards in nearly 10 minutes on their first drive ending with a roman wilson 12 yard touchdown off a rodgers pop pass thereafter pittsburgh was stymied scoring three points over its next seven drives until the steelers defense forced a pair of late takeaways perhaps most peculiar was why jaylen warren who had 93 yards on 17 carries wasn t fed more there s plenty of football left this season but this wasn t pretty for pittsburgh browns defense kicking game win the night cleveland was excellent defensively and its special teams units were outstanding denzel ward s interception of rodgers to open the second quarter completely turned the game the first of three cleveland takeaways ward s pick came on the drive following the steelers opening possession march in which they methodically worked their way to a 7 0 lead it invigorated the offense as well which answered with browns touchdowns on three straight drives the three takeaways and the bullying of rodgers in the backfield were the biggest keys for a browns defense highlighted by carson schwesinger nine tackles sam williams sack four qb pressures and isaiah mcguire three tackles sack four qb pressures special teams can t be overlooked though szmyt has been perfect all year and that continued with the first of his three extra points thursday to his 56 yard game winner his second fg in the win for the season he s now 8 of 8 on three pointers and 7 for 7 on singles when points weren t being produced punter corey bojorquez did his part with a performance that can t go unmentioned on four punts bojorquez averaged an incredible 62 8 yards with one downed on the steelers 1 yard line and another going 81 yards young talent shows out for browns there were flashes aplenty from the browns youthful skill position players and they played monster roles in the browns offensive surge in the second quarter cleveland turned a 7 0 deficit into a 21 7 advantage jaleel mclaughlin the 26 year old ex bronco began the scoring parade with a 28 yard run in which he juked one defender and ran through another rookie wide receiver denzel boston is quickly becoming one of the league s most dangerous deep threats as his browns season long 60 yard grab set up quinshon judkins 2 yard touchdown run 2026 first round wideout kc concepcion s quickness and run after catch ability have made him and boston a nightmare combo concepcion 22 had five catches for 64 yards while boston 22 snagged four grabs for 89 yards fannin 22 had the browns last td of the game in the second quarter to conclude the scoring surge sustaining the offensive output is a work in progress but the young browns nucleus has helped the team to an impressive start and underscored that there is more reason for optimism steelers weren t better defense in this one t j watt has a penchant for making big plays on big stages he did so thursday credited with a forced fumble and the subsequent recovery late in the third quarter robert spears jennings interception on the next browns drive led to the steelers flirting with a comeback after rodgers hooked up with darnell washington for a score it wasn t enough though watson was pressured on just 21 6 of his dropbacks per next gen stats and sacked twice that s not going to get it done this is a highly paid and high profile defense with watt jalen ramsey nick herbig keeanu benton and others it was hardly terrible on thursday but it wasn t the dominant force it needs to be to take over games and rack up wins it started well enough but it was the browns defenders who dictated this one not the steelers next gen stats insight for steelers browns via nfl pro pittsburgh s defense pressured deshaun watson on 21 6 of his dropbacks the eighth lowest pressure rate generated by a defense this season watson completed 3 of 5 passes for 27 yards with an interception under pressure nfl research the browns won their eighth straight thursday game extending the longest active streak in the nfl in doing so cleveland snapped first year steelers head coach mike mccarthy s seven game winning streak on thursdays which extended back to his time with the cowboys

news_mentions.headline: Commissioner Roger Goodell meets with Illinois governor as Bears continue pursuit of new stadium
news_mentions.description: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell met with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker and the leadership of the state's General Assembly on Thursday, adding another wrinkle to the Chicago Bears' long-running pursuit of a new home.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl commissioner roger goodell met with illinois gov jb pritzker and the leadership of the state s general assembly on thursday adding another wrinkle to the chicago bears long running pursuit of a new home the bears said in august that the franchise s sole focus for the construction of a new stadium and mixed use development was on hammond indiana but the public confirmation of the conversation between goodell and pritzker indicates that illinois remains in the mix the bears also had been considering arlington heights about 30 miles northwest of chicago as a potential location for an enclosed stadium illinois speaker emanuel chris welch state sen bill cunningham and state rep kam buckner joined pritzker at the meeting as the president pro tempore of the illinois senate cunningham frequently serves as the body s presiding officer and buckner s district includes soldier field the current home for the bears pat ryan a billionaire minority investor in the bears and a member of the team s board of directors also attended the governor s office has remained in conversation with the bears about their plans in illinois throughout the summer pritzker s office said in a statement the governor and general assembly leadership were glad to participate in a productive meeting focused on keeping the bears in illinois and protecting taxpayers the nfl said in a release that it appreciated the opportunity to meet with pritzker and the state legislators timely action is essential as the bears work to find a long term stadium solution for the club and their fans the league said a message was left by the associated press seeking comment from the team the bears a charter nfl franchise have played in illinois since the team s founding in 1920 as the decatur staleys they moved to chicago in 1921 and called wrigley field home before they started playing at soldier field in september 1971 the bears lease runs through 2033 but they can pay a fee to break the lease early soldier field is about 40 miles south of halas hall the team s headquarters in lake forest illinois and hammond is about 20 miles south of the team s lakefront stadium the bears ramped up their focus on indiana after a proposal to provide financial incentives for the team to build its new home in illinois stalled in the state legislature a committee in the indiana house of representatives passed a bill in february that established a northwest indiana stadium authority to finance construct and lease a stadium the illinois senate passed a bill that would have cleared the way for arlington heights and chicago to create local stadium authorities creating a pathway for the bears to avoid paying property taxes on a new stadium but the house adjourned without taking up the measure on the last day of the state s spring legislative session the bears have been pursuing a new home for years but the process has been hampered by repeated twists and turns the team announced in september 2021 that it had signed a purchase agreement for 326 acres of land in arlington heights the 197 million deal with churchill downs inc was finalized in 2023 in september 2022 the team unveiled a nearly 5 billion plan for arlington heights that called for an enclosed stadium that could host super bowls and final fours the conceptual illustrations also provided for a year round entertainment district with restaurants and shopping but the bears shifted their focus toward building a new stadium next to soldier field after kevin warren was hired as team president in january 2023 the plan to transform chicago s museum campus got an enthusiastic endorsement from mayor brandon johnson but a tepid reception from pritzker and state legislators when it was announced in april 2024 the team switched gears again in may 2025 announcing it had made significant progress with local leaders in arlington heights amid lingering efforts to secure tax incentives in illinois along with as much as 855 million in public money for infrastructure at the arlington heights site the bears began to take a closer look at possible options in northwest indiana warren said in august that the team was in regular almost daily communication with the state of indiana working on the project he called it an excellent deal a win win partnership together copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Jets' Aaron Glenn looking forward to facing Ben Johnson, Bears: 'He's a damn good coach'
news_mentions.description: Jets HC Aaron Glenn is set to face a familiar foe for the second straight week when his team takes on Ben Johnson's Bears.
news_mentions.body_text: aaron glenn is on an unintentional reunion tour in weeks 3 and 4 the former lions defensive coordinator returned to detroit with his new york jets last week falling 31 24 to dan campbell and co this sunday glenn s jets will face former lions offensive coordinator ben johnson s chicago bears whom glenn knows quite well from their many practices spent battling against each other in detroit we were so competitive in move the ball situations on how we wanted to beat each other but it made both of us better i will say that glenn said wednesday about going up against johnson during lions practices via the jets official site he s a damn good coach those practices were famously competitive the 2022 season of hbo s hard knocks featured the lions which meant the up close look at the up and coming team would undoubtedly include some footage of these sessions and glenn and running backs coach duce staley didn t disappoint in their trash talk given how the lions transformed into a perennial contender in the ensuing seasons it s no surprise campbell s lieutenants have taken top jobs elsewhere one of these two is a step ahead of the other as of now though johnson has a 2025 division title and playoff win on his resume as bears coach while glenn is still working toward transforming the jets when you have coordinators offensive and defensive coordinators you re really planning practice glenn said you re really planning the things you want to see against each other so the communication between me and him was always outstanding just talking offensive and defensive football was good to have this portion of the jets 2026 schedule is either a coincidence or a cruel joke the connections don t stop here either new york faces the cleveland browns for whom staley serves as running backs coach in week 5 it s also serving as a quality test of glenn s jets and where they stand in their second year under his direction observers will note new york has played much more competitively through three weeks than they did at almost any point in the 2025 season and if glenn needed his own measuring stick he s receiving two in consecutive weeks he ll have his hands full this week johnson s bears aren t expected to have budding star quarterback caleb williams available due to a hamstring injury suffered in week 2 but after 38 year old third stringer case keenum carved up the philadelphia eagles on monday night glenn s jets might have to prepare for any of chicago s three quarterbacks adding more work to his plate glenn isn t going to back down though much like the heated sessions on the practice fields in michigan he ll bring his full effort primarily because he knows it s required johnson has those guys playing really really well glenn said we re looking forward to having a good week of practice and getting ready to go compete against a really good team our guys will be ready to do that

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker, 49ers QB Brock Purdy highlight September Players of the Month
news_mentions.description: San Francisco quarterback Brock Purdy and Kansas City running back Kenneth Walker are among those honored in with Player of the Month accolades.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in september each month the league unveils its honor roll see who the players of the month are below afc offensive player of the month the chiefs ballyhooed free agent addition has paid immediate dividends walker blasted off with 173 rushing yards and three total touchdowns in the chiefs season opening win as kansas city has raced to a 3 0 start walker s been the offense s motor posting four scrimmage touchdowns two receiving two rushing and heads into october as the nfl s leading rusher with 360 yards nfc offensive player of the month through three games and three victories purdy has been nearly flawless purdy has sparkled to the tune of 60 of 83 passing 72 3 for 789 yards and nine touchdowns with just one interception he s also rushed for 93 yards eight first downs and a touchdown on 10 carries the 49ers 3 0 are undefeated and purdy is atop the nfl in touchdown passes tied for first and passer rating 133 1 and has yet to take a sack afc defensive player of the month every bills game so far has ended with a buffalo victory and rousseau recording two sacks rousseau has piled up 15 tackles an nfl leading eight tackles for loss three forced fumbles and a league leading six sacks which are just two off his career high for a season nfc defensive player of the month the giants are tied for first in the nfc east and holland has been a huge reason why his three interceptions are tied for the nfl lead and he s had one in each game along with a pair of forced fumbles 12 tackles and four pass breakups throw in a fumble recovery and holland s four takeaways are an nfl best afc special teams player of the month it was a perfect september for mcpherson the bengals big boot has converted each of his eight extra points and all of his eight field goal tries among those eight fgs mcpherson has made an nfl high five from 50 plus nfc special teams player of the month a day after hauling in nfc special teams player of the week price is right back for monthly honors after all he leads the nfl with 353 kick return yards and likewise leads the league with 130 punt return yards on sunday he turned in an 86 yard punt return for a touchdown thus far the only pr td in the nfl this year offensive rookie of the month what a story benson is penning through three nfl games the undrafted free agent has started each game for an undefeated chiefs squad and has now become the first lineman to win offensive rookie of the month since the colts quenton nelson in october 2018 the accolade is richly deserved benson who amazingly never played left tackle in college at indiana has allowed just seven qb pressures and one sack on 106 pass blocks 6 6 pressure rate 0 9 sack rate defensive rookie of the month in a crowded pool of defensive rookie standouts such as the commanders sonny styles and the raiders hezekiah masses the nfl s leading tackler has garnered recognition hill also has a pair of pass breakups in his three starts and has quickly developed a reputation as being a sure tackler his 5 6 missed tackle rate is seventh lowest among qualified off ball linebackers and his 12 run stops are fifth at his position per next gen stats

news_mentions.headline: NFL's Crucial Catch surpasses 1 million cancer screenings, continues efforts to expand access to early detection resources
news_mentions.description: The NFL will mark a major Crucial Catch milestone this season, surpassing more than 1.1 million cancer screenings supported in under-resourced communities through its cancer awareness, early detection and risk reduction initiative
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl will mark a major crucial catch milestone this season surpassing more than 1 1 million cancer screenings supported in under resourced communities through its cancer awareness early detection and risk reduction initiative developed in partnership with the american cancer society crucial catch will return to the field during weeks 4 6 as the nfl continues helping expand access to screening resources and support communities facing barriers to care since 2009 the nfl has raised more than 38 million through crucial catch branded merchandise nfl auction items and other fundraising efforts to support the american cancer society s work to improve cancer screening in under resourced communities those efforts have helped reach more than 2 7 million people with cancer education patient navigation screening reminders and resources fans can take action for their health by visiting nfl com crucialcatch to find cancer prevention and screening resources near them including the american cancer society s 24 7 cancer helpline live chat support and a cancer screening locator presented by novartis pharmaceuticals corporation the nfl s official corporate pharmaceutical partner the site also features the defender quiz and personalized screening reminders to help fans better understand their risk and take steps to support early detection crucial catch demonstrates what is possible when the nfl the american cancer society our clubs players partners and fans come together around a shared commitment to saving lives said anna isaacson nfl senior vice president of social responsibility for more than 15 seasons this initiative has helped bring vital cancer education and screening resources to communities across the country we know early detection can make a meaningful difference but too many people still face barriers to care through crucial catch we are continuing to use the power of football to help close those gaps and make progress toward reducing health disparities the american cancer society is working in communities across the country side by side with local health centers health systems and partners people know and trust said shane jacobson chief executive officer of the american cancer society through crucial catch the nfl is helping expand that work so more people can access trusted screening support close to home that local collaboration is what makes this initiative real and it is how we continue improving cancer outcomes for more people expanding access crucial catch supports the american cancer society s community health advocates implementing nationwide grants for empowerment and equity change program which helps community health centers and nfl affiliated or in market hospitals in under resourced areas improve access to breast cervical colorectal lung and prostate cancer screening in 2026 64 nfl funded change grant projects will support community health centers and health systems across nfl markets helping expand access to breast cervical colorectal lung and prostate cancer screening in communities with the greatest need the complete list of 2026 change grant recipients and market map is available here across the nfl throughout the season crucial catch showcases the league s year round commitment to making a positive impact in the fight against cancer while addressing disparities in underserved communities during weeks 4 6 fans will see that commitment come to life through crucial catch game balls goal post wraps field wall banners and branded on field apparel and equipment for players coaches and officials fans can support their favorite team and join the fight against cancer by purchasing nfl licensed crucial catch apparel through nfl shop including a new pink option available this season game worn crucial catch merchandise will be auctioned on nfl auction at nfl com auction the nfl does not profit from the sale of crucial catch merchandise charitable contributions are awarded by the nfl foundation to the american cancer society players and clubs will also bring crucial catch to life through local activations personal storytelling and cause efforts that connect fans with teams and players in meaningful ways as part of this year s crucial catch initiative the nfl will debut a dedicated campaign spot featuring crucial catch ambassador demario davis that highlights the importance of early detection the spot will run within the nfl s 2026 cause platform there is no i in change a season long campaign that highlights the collective efforts of players clubs partners and communities working together to drive positive change through the american cancer society player ambassador program nfl players with a personal connection to cancer including colston loveland dak prescott justin jefferson and jaxon smith njigba will amplify crucial catch s mission through appearances fundraising campaigns and social media awareness initiatives the full list of 2026 crucial catch player ambassadors is available here in the community this season the nfl and american cancer society will launch crucial catch live the tour sponsored by novartis bringing cancer education and screening opportunities directly to fans and local communities the tour launched in chicago on sept 30 and will continue throughout the season and beyond with additional activations in charlotte super bowl lxi and the 2027 nfl draft

news_mentions.headline: Patrick Mahomes eager to face Maxx Crosby after odd offseason: Chiefs-Raiders is 'pure football'
news_mentions.description: Patrick Mahomes is back from his season-ending ACL injury and playing excellently, and edge rusher Maxx Crosby is out to ruin Mahomes' day -- and add a little trash talk on top.
news_mentions.body_text: it s been a long time since the raiders and chiefs met with identically undefeated records that s what s on deck for sunday though with 3 0 las vegas hosting 3 0 kansas city at allegiant stadium it s a matchup that is as surprising on paper as it is anticipated by both parties the contest includes two stars who will compete against each other plenty quarterback patrick mahomes is back from his season ending acl injury and playing excellently and edge rusher maxx crosby is out to ruin mahomes day and add a little trash talk on top i m here that s all i m going to have for now mahomes said wednesday when asked if he and crosby have had memorable exchanges in previous meetings i think it s just being competitors it s almost like whenever you re young and you re competing with one of your friends man you want to win because you kind of have those bragging rights and you kind of go into the offseason and if you see the guy you can kind of give him a little something here and there it s something about that it s just what the pure football is is having the best competitors compete against each other and that s what i think you really get whenever you go out there and it s raiders versus chiefs mahomes and crosby are each coming off unusually eventful offseasons for a few days in march crosby was destined to move to baltimore and become a raven baltimore s cold feet nixed that deal sending crosby back to the afc west to continue harassing mahomes the superstar quarterback meanwhile was in the midst of a long recovery from knee surgery necessitated by a december injury he actually texted me right when i got cleared to play and just kind of said hey we re both back and for me i was just kind of like let s show the world who we are mahomes said of his interaction with crosby and so i think that s just the competitors in this league there is a rivalry when we step on that field we re going to go at it that s just kind of what it is and we both know that but at the end of the day man you want the great competitors the great players in this league because it makes the league better and it makes when you go out there and do get the win even better both have had points to prove early in the 2026 season and both are riding high after three straight victories to begin the campaign they re playing great football you can see it on tape mahomes said of the raiders that 3 0 record s real they ve been playing great the entire season and so for us it s another step another challenge that we have to go up there and match by the time the clock strikes zero sunday one will no longer be perfect while the other will have a new feather in their well worn rivalry cap i just know when i step on that football field i m going to need my best because he s going to bring his best mahomes said and i think that s when you get the best games out there

news_mentions.headline: Bears' Ben Johnson won't reveal Week 4 starting QB after Keenum stunner: 'Looking at everything'
news_mentions.description: When spending his summer preparing for the 2026 season, Bears coach Ben Johnson probably didn't anticipate a quarterback conundrum.
news_mentions.body_text: when spending his summer preparing for the 2026 season bears coach ben johnson probably didn t anticipate a quarterback conundrum that s not exactly what s happening in chicago right now either but johnson spent his wednesday fielding questions regarding who will start under center for him in week 4 against the visiting jets unsurprisingly he didn t provide a firm answer we ve got three guys johnson said via the team s official site we ll work through the week and see where they re at logic and recent events would lead one to expect johnson to continue with 38 year old case keenum the 14 year veteran who propelled the bears to a 20 point win over the eagles on monday night by completing 24 of 34 passes for 247 yards and two touchdowns it s not quite that simple though keenum is listed as chicago s third string quarterback behind younger backup tyson bagent and madden nfl 27 cover star caleb williams whose week 2 hamstring injury threw the bears into uncertainty keenum was initially an afterthought too until it was revealed bagent had suffered a concussion in the week 2 loss to minnesota and was in concussion protocol keenum responded as any capable experienced veteran would stepping into the role and giving his best effort it produced stunning results helping the bears to a dominant victory and settling the concerns regarding chicago s situation under center for a week that doesn t mean johnson is necessarily going to ride the hot hand though we re looking at everything johnson said he played really well the other night sure that plays a part of the evaluation johnson has a game for which he must plan of course and determining who is handling the snaps is an important part of the process he s already completed that process the coach said wednesday he just isn t revealing who he s selected instead he s keeping that secret as a competitive advantage in the meantime folks outside halas hall can spend the week reviewing what s occurred and conclude it s especially helpful to have three competent quarterbacks on a roster johnson would agree it s not hard for me at all he said i feel really good about all three quarterbacks in that room and i know all three of them can win ballgames for us

news_mentions.headline: Steelers trade CB Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys in exchange for second-, sixth-round picks
news_mentions.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers are trading cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Dallas Cowboys in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick, NFL Network's Jane Slater reported Wednesday evening.
news_mentions.body_text: the steel city impasse is over the pittsburgh steelers are trading cornerback joey porter to the dallas cowboys in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick and a 2028 second round pick nfl network s jane slater reported wednesday evening the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the trade the cowboys announced the terms of the transaction thursday morning porter entering the final season of his 2023 rookie contract was seeking an extension but he and pittsburgh were unable to come to terms the 26 year old porter had missed each of the steelers first three games this season he was listed as having a back injury throughout training camp but as of late had appeared on the steelers practice report as being a full or limited participant due to conditioning earlier thursday porter had been ruled out for the team s thursday night game against the cleveland browns with the designation not injury related conditioning back now the consternation in pittsburgh has concluded and porter whose father was a four time pro bowler and super bowl champion with the steelers from 1999 2011 will move on to helping the cowboys shore up a defense that was supposed to be much improved but has continued to be a disappointment steelers and former cowboys head coach mike mccarthy was upfront in declaring pittsburgh and porter at an impasse this offseason before general manager omar khan declared that there would be no negotiations during the season meanwhile porter hadn t been practicing instead stationed on the physically unable to perform list throughout training camp with the aforementioned back injury he was removed from the pup list on sunday aug 31 to be included on the team s initial 53 man roster days later porter indicated there was a chance he would not play this year without a new deal as it turns out he would never play for the steelers again porter s desire for a lucrative second career contract came as pittsburgh had been shoring up its 2023 draft class having locked up 23 third rounder darnell washington and 23 fourth rounder nick herbig before signing porter s fellow second rounder keeanu bentonto an extension another steelers 2023 pick they did not re sign was first round pick broderick jones who was also traded to the cowboys jones has played in all three games for dallas but just one of his 17 snaps has come on offense porter was taken 32nd overall to begin the second round the 2023 draft had only 31 first round selections after the miami dolphins were penalized and lost theirs and was a mainstay in the steelers starting lineup over the past three years the 6 foot 2 193 pounder has been solid in coverage but has struggled in the run game at times nonetheless he d been a key cog for pittsburgh with 41 starts in three seasons 165 tackles three interceptions and 31 pass breakups he ll join first year cowboys defensive coordinator christian parker whose unit is 30th in total defense the cowboys 1 2 who haven t logged an interception this season have one cornerback spot locked down by daron bland while shavon revel and cobie durant have also earned starts both missed practice on wednesday dallas travels to play the houston texans 0 3 on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Patriots' Drake Maye: Shoulder not impacting throws; no rift with HC Mike Vrabel
news_mentions.description: Patriots QB Drake Maye told reporters that his right shoulder, which appeared on Wednesday's injury report, is not impacting how he's throwing the ball.
news_mentions.body_text: trouble in paradise now includes a health concern for drake maye the quarterback landed on new england s wednesday injury report with a right shoulder injury but was a full participant in the day s practice maye was asked on wednesday if his shoulder is impacting how he s throwing the football no it hasn t maye said i don t think it impacts my decision making and that s what makes and breaks play for quarterbacks maye instead redirected the attention toward the team s turnover issues which he admitted are holding them back that s this position there are reps in the game and there are ones that cost you maye explained it happens to be that you ve got to outweigh the good with the bad by a wide margin to play well at this position and that s quarterback i m feeling good throwing and i feel like i have some throws i wish i had back as i always do and definitely some decisions but at the same time i ve got to trust my guys and trust the guys up front they re doing a nice job to keep on playing football coach mike vrabel didn t appear to be concerned with his quarterback s status when speaking with reporters prior to wednesday s practice but did have to answer questions regarding a local report from weei s greg hill that suggested there is friction between vrabel and maye he heard from who unnamed sources let me just tell you why i m here vrabel said i m here because drake was the quarterback believe it or not i had choices as to where i wanted to coach i wanted to coach here because drake was the quarterback so i don t have really much other to add to that about a comment from an unnamed source but i ll just tell you what i ve told numerous people if they want to ask me why i m here after three weeks new england is 1 2 but occupies a place that seems much more nightmarish than the team s record might suggest maye has played a major role in their difficulties creating space for the locals to sow discord maye has struggled significantly to start the 2026 season throwing three interceptions in the season s kickoff game a 13 10 loss to seattle and committing seven giveaways in three contests in new england s lopsided 35 6 defeat in jacksonville on sunday maye accounted for all three patriots turnovers including a couple of ghastly interceptions and a fumble in which the ball slipped out of his hand as he was winding to throw his numbers have fallen accordingly after throwing for 4 394 yards and posting a 31 8 td int ratio in 2025 production worthy of an nfl mvp finalist spot maye has completed 63 8 percent of his passes for 585 yards and a 1 6 td int ratio in 2026 his passer rating has dropped by 54 9 points the largest decrease from one season to the next among qualifying quarterbacks in the super bowl era per nfl research at one point during sunday s loss patriots color commentator scott zolak suggested vrabel might bench maye for backup tommy devito it eventually happened in the fourth quarter but only because the game was out of reach afterward vrabel expressed his concern level is very high for this football team an accurate assessment of the defending afc champions who have looked nothing like it through three weeks that doesn t mean vrabel is suddenly at odds with his quarterback coach vrabel s been one of the best football coaches i ve had in my life maye said on wednesday when asked of the reported rift i think coach vrabel s been one of the biggest things as to why this has been so enjoyable for me is playing for coach i think we all feel that way in the locker room he pushes us hard i ve loved playing for him and it s not going to change it hasn t changed and it won t change the way he pushes me and he coaches the quarterbacks in a way that i really respect and i m looking forward to getting going proving to coach that i can lead this football team and play good football instead of spending his days refuting reports of internal conflict vrabel is dedicating himself to helping his quarterback improve it s essential to the patriots efforts of repeating as afc east champions ahead of a big week 4 game at the 3 0 bills on sunday well the same thing i ve been doing just trying to coach the football team trying to coach him vrabel said when asked how he could help maye climb out of his slump i m not going to coach him the x s and o s i mean i can show him the defense and say hey this is what these guys may like to try to do but it s just about the urgency that we have how we operate and how we get in and out of the huddle and the command of the huddle the quarterback is a conduit to offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and the play caller i firmly believe that the way that they tell the players that they re playing with like hey this is what we re going to do this play is going to work not because it s some great scheme it s going to work because we re going to execute it or we re going to make it work and you get them to believe that whatever he calls is going to be successful now will every one be no that s not how it goes but that s what i try to teach them each and every day maye s partnership with mcdaniels worked wonderfully in 2025 en route to a surprising super bowl trip making their struggles that much more shocking it s early though and as vrabel said if maye can eliminate his negative plays their issues will eventually dissipate just don t expect him to say much more about a rumored conflict

news_mentions.headline: Rams head coach Sean McVay: WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to return for Rams Sunday vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams expect wide receiver Puka Nacua to play in Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles after missing the team's last two games with a hip/groin injury.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams are ready to welcome back a major piece of their offense los angeles expects receiver puka nacua to play in sunday s game against the philadelphia eagles coach sean mcvay told reporters wednesday nacua was officially a limited participant in wednesday s practice a sign that he s nearing a return defensive tackle aaron donald meanwhile did not practice to back soreness per mcvay nacua has been battling a hip and groin injury related to his psoas since training camp inspiring concern he might be headed for surgery at some point in 2026 he managed to suit up for the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in melbourne australia in week 1 catching five passes for 74 yards but he s since been sidelined missing the rams last two games without nacua quarterback matthew stafford has leaned heavily on fellow veteran davante adams connecting with the three time all pro 15 times for 332 yards and two touchdowns in the last two weeks the production has been plentiful but without nacua it s also caused the rams to become a bit more predictable especially in the second half of the rams week 3 loss to denver underscoring their need for nacua s return it sounds as if that will happen sunday against an eagles team that is reeling from a lopsided loss to the chicago bears in which 38 year old quarterback case keenum threw for 247 yards and two touchdowns if nacua can fit back into the offense quickly stafford could be in line for an even more prolific afternoon

news_mentions.headline: Titans HC Robert Saleh: Cam Ward has 'some PTSD' from number of sacks in rookie season
news_mentions.description: The Titans offense has struggled to start the season. Head coach Robert Saleh attributed some of Robert Saleh's struggles to "some PTSD" from the number of sacks he endured during his rookie season.
news_mentions.body_text: the tennessee titans offense has lived in strugglesville through three games to start the 2026 season with second year qb cam ward leading an inefficient operation in week 3 s 12 7 loss to the new york giants tennessee began with five straight three and out drives and managed a meager 54 yards of total offense in the first half the titans got back in the game late with three lengthy drives in the third and fourth quarters but ward s forced game sealing interception in the final seconds led the club to 0 3 first year titans head coach robert saleh was asked wednesday about the qb s struggles you ve got to remember the young man was sacked however many times last year so i m sure there s some ptsd there saleh said but he s getting better he s trusting it his footwork is lasting him longer into games if that makes sense but from an accuracy standpoint decision making standpoint everything starts with your feet at the quarterback position ward took 55 sacks in 2025 tied for the league lead with geno smith of the las vegas raiders saleh noted that ward s mechanics come and go within contests you see him comfortable in the pocket he said on wednesday you see him trusting the offensive line and later in the game you kind of see him kind of revert back to some old habits but i do think he s getting better in that regard i think he s starting to really appreciate the offensive line because i think they are doing a really good job protecting him ward is a streaky passer when he s in rhythm and he reads the defense properly the titans offense moves sunday s game was an example of both the bad and good in the first half ward never found a rhythm and was off a smidge on several throws in the second half as he trusted his protection more he released some on target lasers for now this is who ward is a rollercoaster qb the game losing int was an example of a still young player trying to make a play he should have tossed it away and lived for another down that s the sort of mistake the second year qb must weed out of his game i just don t think i played my best in critical situations ward said on wednesday when i need to play my best i didn t that s something i gotta get better at that s something i need to attack this week and going into the next game with baltimore and houston on tap next saleh must hope ward makes those strides quickly i think we re going to eventually get to a point where he s not even thinking twice and none of us are even talking about this anymore saleh said he is working relentlessly i know oc brian daboll and his staff work relentlessly with him to make sure that he s being shown where he can be better and where he s been good and we ll just keep getting better at it

news_mentions.headline: 20th anniversary of Superdome reopening: Revisiting key moments from Saints' emotional win over Falcons
news_mentions.description: During Monday night's rivalry game against Atlanta, New Orleans will celebrate the 20th anniversary of the Superdome's reopening following Hurricane Katrina. Nick Shook looks back at key moments from the Saints' emotional win over the Falcons on Sept. 25, 2006.
news_mentions.body_text: monday s prime time showdown between the atlanta falcons and new orleans saints is not just the latest edition of one of the nfl s most heated rivalries though plenty will be on the line in the week 4 finale it s the 20th anniversary of one of the most meaningful nights in league history when the falcons and saints kick off monday night football in new orleans it will be 20 years and 10 days since the superdome reopened following hurricane katrina on that night sept 25 2006 atlanta and new orleans met in a nationally televised contest also on espn that was the saints first game at the superdome since dec 26 2004 it was a home opener yes but much more than that it represented a welcome return to normalcy for a city that had been out of sorts for more than a year during the 2005 season the saints played home games at giants stadium in new jersey the alamodome in san antonio and tiger stadium in baton rouge louisiana as the superdome underwent a 10 month restoration to fix damage caused by hurricane katrina week 3 s contest against the nfc south rival falcons marked the saints return to the comfy confines that had been repaired and refurbished in record time plenty of reconstruction was left to complete throughout the city new orleans was still fighting to get back on its feet but finally after a devastating weather event changed their lives forever new orleanians had something to cheer for and as they saw it they had a message of revival to deliver to the rest of the nation new coach sean payton ensured his players understood the gravity of the moment holding their thursday night practice in the superdome and delivering a speech that resonated throughout the organization look it s going to be a special night but it s only going to be special if we win payton told them as he recalled in timeline rebirth in new orleans if we lose it s just another football game so i want you to go home and get ready to come back here and kick some a that night in that building i think was the first time we felt pressure former saints linebacker scott fujita recalled because that s when you recognized how big this thing was the homecoming or rather domecoming was an achievement in itself so too was the 23 3 triumph over the falcons earned in front of dignitaries from the football world longtime nfl commissioner paul tagliabue and his successor roger goodell and beyond former president george h w bush handled the coin toss after a pregame concert performed by green day and u2 as many who were there that night have recounted the energy mirrored that of a super bowl with meaning that stretched far beyond simple athletic competition i vividly remember looking across the field and seeing the falcons and looking up at the crowd in the dome and thinking it was impossible for us to lose tonight former saints safety steve gleason said in timeline rebirth in new orleans with another falcons saints showdown in the big easy approaching let s take a look back at some of the highlights from that legendary night beginning with one of the most iconic plays in saints history steve gleason s blocked punt it s the play that inspired a statue and delivered the surge of life new orleans needed to officially christen the city s rebirth it s also the play that defined one man s playing career and the battle he s faced in retirement against als new orleans forced a three and out on atlanta s first possession of the game prompting the falcons to send out michael koenen to punt gleason the fan favorite and saints special teams captain led the punt return unit onto the field he identified the perfect look to execute payton s punt block stunting from one a gap to the other upon the snap and sprinting through untouched diving with outstretched arms to block koenen s punt as the sound of koenen s punt hitting gleason s gloved hands traveled through the air the superdome erupted fellow special teamer curtis deloatch was first to arrive at the live ball falling on it in the end zone for the saints first score at the superdome in more than a year it was like a shotgun blast saints icon drew brees said in timeline rebirth in new orleans i ve to this day never heard a sound more meaningful than that football hitting steve gleason s hands when he blocked it that s what that moment became known as the rebirth of new orleans fujita said saints score again on trick play td if gleason s blocked punt and deloatch s recovery for a touchdown weren t fitting enough for the momentous occasion an even stronger louisiana connection found the end zone for the saints later in the first quarter with new orleans at atlanta s 11 yard line and threatening to widen their lead payton decided it was time to take a creative risk in his first home game as saints coach payton dialed up some trickery calling for a double reverse that included brees reggie bush and lsu product devery henderson required brees to make a courageous lead block and ended with henderson in the end zone espn play by play commentator mike tirico made sure to shout out henderson s lsu background where he was part of another memorable play in louisiana lore known as the bluegrass miracle and finish the call with touchdown new orleans signifying this was much more than just another prime time football game special teams blocks another kick the third phase heroics didn t end with gleason s punt block holding a 17 3 lead shortly before halftime the saints defense bowed up in the shadow of their own goal post preventing the falcons from reaching the end zone and forcing them to settle for a chip shot field goal except most chip shots don t include intentional obstructions with 1 54 remaining in the second quarter eventual pro football hall of famer morten andersen lined up for a 25 yard field goal from the right hash as the snap fired back to the atlanta holder saints defensive back josh bullocks knifed through the falcons line gaining unrestricted entry into the backfield and throwing both arms into the air his right arm connected with andersen s angled kick denying the falcons a scoring opportunity and standing as the saints second special teams block of the night saints swallow up michael vick vick entered the game as the face of atlanta s franchise and the foil to new orleans special night he left as the roughed up target of the saints aggression new orleans sacked vick five times on the night for a combined loss of 25 yards with three of the quarterback takedowns coming in the fourth quarter the saints penultimate sack saw new orleans dial up an interior twist freeing defensive tackle brian young whose pursuit of vick forced the quarterback to duck in order to slip his tackle attempt waiting on the other end of vick s evasive maneuver was charles grant who fought through a holding penalty on right tackle todd weiner to take down vick the game was essentially already over by that point with the saints leading 23 3 halfway through the final period but the unrelenting effort really summed up new orleans inspired performance on a truly inspiring night

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback max melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return to sunday s game against the commanders green bay packers wide receiver jayden reed exited sunday s win over the jets on a stretcher after he was hit in the head area by a defender in the first quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle zach bako bewele knee was carted off the field with an air cast placed on his injured leg bako bewele also was ruled out guard aaron banks toe was ruled out in the fourth quarter and defensive tackle anthony campbell ankle did not return indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce was carted to the locker room during the first half versus the chiefs and ruled out with a heel injury x rays were negative but pierce who was in a boot and using crutches after the game will undergo further testing on monday per espn cb charvarius ward left sunday night s loss with a groin injury los angeles chargers tight end david njoku knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders miami dolphins running back jaylen wright stinger and defensive end robert beal hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to san francisco minnesota vikings defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins hip did not return to sunday s win over the bears new england patriots offensive lineman mike onwenu ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s win over the steelers espn com reported after the game that initial x rays showed onwenu broke his right ankle tight end eli raridon thigh also was ruled out linebacker dre 39 mont jones shoulder and safety dell pettus ankle did not return new york jets defensive lineman david onyemata groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the packers linebackers marcelino mccrary ball ankle and kiko mauigoa quad also did not return philadelphia eagles tight end dallas goedert knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans running back saquon barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger barkley returned to the field after halftime barkley said after the game that he will undergo an mri pittsburgh steelers running back rico dowdle toe missed part of the first half of sunday s loss to the patriots before returning after halftime san francisco 49ers receiver demarcus robinson ankle was ruled out of sunday s game against the dolphins head coach kyle shanahan told reporters after the game robinson and dt james thompson have high ankle sprains wide receiver mike evans hip did not return to the game but the injury doesn t look serious per shanahan seattle seahawks running back jadarian price chest did not return to sunday s game against the cardinals hc mike macdonald said after the game that x rays came back negative on price s injury washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels dislocated his left elbow in sunday s loss to the cowboys head coach dan quinn said quinn told reporters that an x ray on daniels elbow didn t show a fracture but the qb will undergo more testing daniels was ruled out after getting injured at the end of the first half versus dallas he was seen leaving the stadium with his arm in a sling per local reporters sunday s game between the cleveland browns and tampa bay buccaneers was suspended in the fourth quarter due to lightning in the area the delay lasted over two hours before play resumed at 6 10 p m et

news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 1 sunday atlanta falcons defensive lineman da 39 shawn hand knee was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the steelers offensive lineman chris lindstrom concussion was also ruled out baltimore ravens wide receiver zay flowers hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over the colts flowers had five catches for 150 yards and one touchdown before exiting nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday morning that flowers injury is not considered serious but the wr will undergo garafolot reported chicago bears cornerback tyrique stevenson shoulder exited sunday s win over the panthers and did not return cleveland browns running back dylan sampson ankle was ruled out in the s win over the saints and did not return houston texans linebacker jake hummel abdomen was ruled out of sunday s loss to the bills jacksonville jaguars defensive end bj green elbow exited sunday s win s loss to the cardinals new york jets safety minkah fitzpatrick groin did not return to sunday s win over the titans wide receiver omar cooper ankle was ruled out cooper s x rays were negative but he ruled out after suffering a concussion in the first half of sunday s win over the packers tampa bay buccaneers cornerback jacob parrish back was ruled out of sunday s loss to the bengals washington commanders tight end chigoziem okonkwo hamstring linebacker frankie luvu groin and safety tyler owens ankle did not return to sunday s loss to the eagles

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches
