for offensive production over the years is facing a commanders run defense that ranks third in the nfl through three weeks taylor is an international legend after last year s blistering berlin showing but he hasn t broken 100 yards in a game this season washington has been careful with the ball on offense committing just one giveaway all year while the colts defense has been among the league s worst in terms of yards and points allowed but also takeaways 1 both clubs are turning a corner after getting off the schneid in week 3 but the commanders are in a better place even with their starting quarterback rehabbing another dislocated elbow editor s update washington coach dan quinn announced on friday that jayden daniels has been ruled out of sunday s game veteran qb marcus mariota will make his second straight start after leading the commanders to a 33 31 upset win over the seahawks why jeremy picked the ravens derrick henry s first meeting with his former team isn t necessarily a revenge game after all he left the titans in 2024 as they downsized and little of the regime that shipped him out remains that fact won t stop henry from trying to run all over tennessee on sunday afternoon history however may be against henry no player has ever rushed for at least 100 yards against a team with which he recorded at least 9 000 career rushing yards plus the titans for all their faults in this season s early going have been competitive against the run allowing just 3 6 yards per attempt when henry plows into the teeth of the titans front on sunday jeffery simmons has vowed to hit his ass tennessee s main issue remains cam ward the offense and its slow starts the titans should expect no relief against a ravens outfit rejuvenated by its resounding win in rio why gennaro picked the bills what is the best representation of new england s well documented offensive struggles i m partial to one simple statistic that has made the rounds this week in 30 offensive drives this season the patriots have scored 29 points for comparison s sake the bills have logged 32 offensive drives and scored 101 points another painful pats stat that s burning up the interwebs going back to january s playoffs drake maye has turned the ball over 15 times in his past seven games what on earth has happened to last season s mvp runner up the 24 year old s putrid play has spawned theories far and wide some more conspiratorial than others is cover 6 his kryptonite is the shoulder still barking from last season s injury is there a rift between maye and mike vrabel i won t pretend to have any of those answers but one thing is pretty easy to surmise the quarterback misses a j brown unfortunately the blockbuster trade acquisition s high ankle sprain is expected to keep him out until late october and in the here and now new england s other notable offseason addition out wide romeo doubs has gotten off to a rough start in foxborough if maye and co are indeed suffering the infamous super bowl hangover it s hard to believe the best remedy is a trip to buffalo for a game against their undefeated division rivals why brooke picked the bears will the bears start case keenum or tyson bagent at quarterback that s the question ben johnson must weigh the veteran diced up the eagles on monday night but the hc insists there are reasons bagent ended camp as qb2 we ll find out soon enough but no matter the jets have held a lead or been tied in the fourth quarter of all three games but i don t see that to be the case sunday after myriad injuries to key jets including rb breece hall wr adonai mitchell te mason taylor og dylan parham all are week to week per hc aaron glenn the offense faces an uphill climb especially with its bell cow back sidelined against a bears d that has held its last two opponents to fewer than 10 points new york s defense has impressed and made plays to be sure it s good enough to make stops but can it make enough stops to help its undermanned offense keep pace a competitive game gets away from gang green late with the league s top ranked rushing attack running out the clock to give chicago its second straight win at soldier field why bobby picked the jaguars after two superb weeks for cincy s defense bengals fans must have been having flashbacks to recent seasons as their team was suddenly unable to slow down the steelers aaron rodgers threw for over 290 yards and three touchdowns for the first time since he was a packer in 2021 and jaylen warren went off for 176 yards from scrimmage it s just one game but the result also necessitates looking back at the first two weeks that caused cincinnati to earn praise for a supposed offseason transformation the four takeaways against tampa bay in week 1 were great but the bengals still gave up points to an offense that has since struggled and after doing nothing against cincinnati in week 2 houston was just quieted by a colts team that had allowed the second most yards through the first two games in a season in nfl history now the jaguars come to town with the most high functioning offense the bengals have faced thus far by a wide margin they just blew the doors off the reigning afc champions defeating the patriots 35 6 trevor lawrence enters the contest playing well with 616 passing yards seven touchdowns two picks and a 107 8 passer rating if the bengals prove unable to limit the damage again defensively joe burrow and co will have a mighty tough task keeping up against the no 1 defense in points allowed why brooke picked the cowboys the battle for texas is back with both teams aiming to avoid their worst starts since 2020 in two career games against the texans dak prescott has struggled with a 61 8 completion percentage 2 4 td to int ratio and a 69 0 passer rating and he s yet face a demeco ryans led unit with houston or san francisco so things could continue to go south i m a big believer in the texans defense but think the cowboys are too talented an offense to lay down this early in the season that said brian schottenheimer must coach smarter this week and there are major concerns with that defense which continues to get hit with the injury bug it ll be without dt jonathan bullard s jalen thompson and potentially cb shavon revel this week after losing cb cobie durant s p j locke lb demarvion overshown and s malik hooker in weeks prior the cowboys made a trade wednesday night for disgruntled pittsburgh corner joey porter which should aid the waning secondary once he s on the field the saving grace for that unit right now though is that the texans offense has been abysmal scoring a total of 23 points in the last two games notably no 1 receiver nico collins returned to practice wednesday but can his presence alone make all the difference for c j stroud and houston s floundering offense it s definitely possible and i won t be all that shocked if collins spurs the texans to victory but on the whole i ve seen a bit more from dallas at this juncture why jeremy picked the cardinals it s a rivalry renewed in the meadowlands oh you don t remember the old divisional clashes between big blue and the chicago st louis phoenix arizona cardinals well then you surely don t recall that the giants have never beaten the cards in metlife stadium and haven t won against these birds at home since week 1 of 2005 in the kurt warner bowl it s been a while for the g men but will the stain of that two decade long failure play into sunday s showdown the more pressing elements in the game will be whether jameis winston can finally get the giants in the end zone against a cards defense that was exploited by the nfc west elite in weeks 2 and 3 and whether a giants defense sans brian burns can pressure jacoby brissett and co into critical errors at this point in the season i have more faith in the steady brissett and mike lafleur s overachieving cards team than a new york outfit making desperate september trades to stabilize a roster depleted of star power oh yeah and arizona doesn t lose at metlife math why gennaro picked the eagles last sunday night los angeles blew a 16 0 halftime lead at denver to drop back below 500 in a season that began with the rams as prohibitive super bowl favorites one night later philadelphia was blown out of chicago by a bears team that was forced to give case keenum his first start in 1 009 days so after a pair of nationally televised debacles who s in better position to bounce back well the expected return of star wr puka nacua is certainly a boon to sean mcvay s squad but can the rams coach exorcise his demons against the eagles mcvay is 1 6 vs philadelphia having dropped all four matchups against nick sirianni last season s loss at lincoln financial field was particularly painful not only did the rams blow a 19 point third quarter lead but they had two fourth quarter field goal attempts blocked including a would be game winner from 44 yards out on the last snap of the contest in addition to swatting that final kick hulking dt jordan davis memorably scooped up the ball and galloped for an exclamation point touchdown but the big man s triumphant rumble was easily the eagles best run of the day as the rams held saquon barkley to just 55 total yards on 22 touches that was a huge departure from barkley s previous two games against l a when he piled up 534 scrimmage yards philly s had trouble getting a consistent ground attack going under new oc sean mannion but barkley did enjoy success against chicago this past monday night before the game got out of hand potentially signaling a schematic breakthrough in a matchup between two established powers that have yet to play up to their talent level this season i m far from bullish on the eagles but i anticipate sirianni will rally the troops once again versus mcvay with the birds feeling disrespected as home underdogs why bobby picked the buccaneers once upon a time undrafted rookie tommy devito led the giants to a shocking upset over the packers rushing for 71 yards while throwing for another 158 and a touchdown that was against a 2023 version of green bay playing far better than a packers squad currently in full blown crisis mode with baker mayfield out several weeks due to a dislocated thumb undrafted rookie jalon daniels who impressed enough in preseason to win the backup job has a chance to pen a similar story daniels finding a way to spark tampa bay s struggling offense isn t as farfetched as it might seem that s not to say he s the quarterback mayfield is but baker currently sits dead last among qualified quarterbacks with a 35 6 expected points added per nfl pro the bar for daniels to surpass what the 2026 version of mayfield did through three games is not remotely high and everyone saw what michael penix achieved against the packers d during his first game back since tearing his acl on nov 16 last season green bay s thursday night debacle didn t portray its offense in any more of a positive light the offensive line is swiss cheese allowing the quickest average time to pressure 2 29 and struggling to forge a path for the league s worst rushing attack which has managed 146 yards in three games do the patchwork signings of mekhi becton laken tomlinson and kevin zeitler change that not nearly soon enough which could lead to the bucs first win of the season why bobby picked the vikings generally a good rule of thumb is to go with the 3 0 team over the 0 3 one minnesota would be the correct pick regardless of records though the vikings offense which currently sits last in the league in yards should be in line for a reprieve against a porous miami squad the fins rank 28th in points allowed through three weeks and their 0 15 expected points added per play allowed is tied with the colts for worst in the league per nfl pro there might be some concerns moving forward if kyler murray and the offense don t fully wake up against miami but it shouldn t affect this particular result that s because minnesota s dominant defense is set to feast on the dolphins struggling offense which just lost its best player de 39 von achane to a season ending acl tear miami has yet to score more than 13 points this season while the vikings are allowing an average of 13 7 brian flores will ensure the dolphins don t have an easy time trying to buck those trends the most daring defensive coordinator in the league boasts a blitz rate of 68 1 24 2 higher than the second most blitz happy team malik willis enters week 4 tied for the fourth worst completion percentage 50 against blitzes and now he must face the purple porpoise eaters i know dolphins aren t porpoises allow me the alliteration why brooke picked the raiders two of the five remaining undefeateds reside in the afc west and who thought the raiders would be one put your hand down they face their toughest opponent to date in the chiefs whose offense continues to steadily improve with eric bieniemy back as oc see a much improved run game led by the nfl s leading rusher kenneth walker with patrick mahomes leveling back up to his mvp caliber standards and whose defense is a top five overall and scoring unit i believe these raiders are up for the challenge kirk cousins is jibing with klint kubiak s scheme throwing three tds in each game this season and plays well against man coverage which steve spagnuolo s defense runs on 37 6 percent of dropbacks fifth most in the nfl per next gen stats cousins has six pass tds zero ints and a 126 2 passer rating vs man this season while recording three pass tds three ints and an 85 2 passer rating vs zone coverage cousins has time to deal with the way his o line is playing five sacks allowed through three games but the raiders need week 3 afc offensive player of the week brock bowers and ashton jeanty to show up in a big way las vegas leads the league with a 5 turnover differential and defensively the team is tied for fourth in sacks but the raiders must limit walker that s a huge key to this game this is the most inspiring the raiders have looked in eons and though the chiefs might be the more experienced of the two vegas newfound confidence and the energy the black hole will bring to allegiant stadium on sunday will be just enough to eke out a w giving the franchise more wins heading into week 5 than it managed in the entire 2025 season why bobby picked the seahawks the seahawks week 3 loss to the commanders was their first since nov 16 of 2025 when they square off against the chargers they will have suffered just two defeats in the previous 365 days it was shocking to see them falter against a formerly winless washington team led by backup quarterback marcus mariota but that s easy enough to wave away as any given sunday these chargers it s impossible to dismiss all that plagues them they re so offensively challenged that even with the bills turning it over five times they only managed 16 points in their recent loss to buffalo and that was the most los angeles has scored all season regardless of one takeaway filled day the chargers defense isn t performing up to its typical stellar standard the unit currently ranks 20th in points allowed down from ninth in 2025 and first in 2024 the struggles have even carried over to pro bowl kicker cameron dicker who has missed a field goal attempt in each of the last two outings the chargers will be desperate to turn it around sunday and start salvaging their season but the seahawks a much better team will also likely play with a little extra fire coming off such a jaw dropping loss why dan picked the 49ers i d like to see the broncos play a complete game before i predict them to go on the road and defeat the team that s arguably been the best in football through three weeks denver is 2 1 but it s been outscored 40 10 in the first halves of its first three games the concerningly slow starts are not lost on head coach sean payton who said this week that trying to play catch up will cost us in bigger games sunday s matchup feels like it could be one of those featuring two squads with legitimate super bowl aspirations the broncos have already proven they can come back against the league s better teams doing so at home versus the jaguars and rams in consecutive weeks but now they re the visitors against the undefeated 49ers who must be feeling pretty comfy as they prepare for their third consecutive game at levi s stadium a scheduling quirk for a club that opened the season in australia brock purdy is playing at an elite level even with injuries once again plaguing san francisco s receiving corps and kyle shanahan is on a coaching heater dating back to last season it won t come easy but i m expecting the niners to be 4 0 entering week 5 for the first time since 2023 why gennaro picked the lions three weeks into the season detroit ranks near the bottom of the nfl in most defensive categories fortunately the lions continue to field one of the league s most potent offenses having scored exactly 31 points in all three games how will the panthers look to counter defensively that s a good question after all ejiro evero s unit ranks dead last in run defense giving up a bountiful 5 7 yards per carry more than half a yard worse than any other team good luck containing jahmyr gibbs does carolina at least have the horses to keep up with amon ra st brown and jameson williams in the passing game not anymore star cb1 jaycee horn and underrated cb2 mike jackson just hit injured reserve now one thing that could help the panthers slow down the lions is the outdoor environment at bank of america stadium not only is detroit a dome team but at publishing it looks like this could be a rainy weekend in charlotte then again if precipitation ultimately plays a role on sunday night carolina might not be able to take full advantage of detroit s disastrous secondary the panthers should put some points on the board but i ll be surprised if they keep up with the lions posse of playmakers monday oct 5 why dan picked the saints new orleans is a few plays away from being 3 0 right now i can t say the same for the falcons although the rout of a lost green bay team in michael penix s 2026 debut was highly encouraging the saints have the smallest margin of defeat 4 5 among the 16 teams with multiple losses entering week 4 and they beat themselves last sunday turning the ball over on all four of their possessions in the fourth quarter against the raiders i m expecting a cleaner performance from tyler shough who ranks second in the league in passing yards 917 and is tied for third in touchdown passes 8 entering week 4 jeff ulbrich has atlanta s defense playing inspired ball even with injuries to key players but kellen moore s group should provide the stiffest test it s faced so far the superdome crowd always brings the energy and the vibes will likely be off the charts on monday night as the saints celebrate the 20th anniversary of one of the most iconic games in franchise history give me the home team in a tight one thursday s game why dan picked the steelers i know the recent history of the steelers trips to cleveland it s the stuff of nightmares for pittsburgh but i m not ready to trust the browns offense it ranks among the bottom five units in too many categories including total yards third down conversion rate and red zone touchdown percentage now i m certainly not convinced the steelers are a finely tuned offensive machine either even after their 30 point outburst against the bengals mike mccarthy s crew was held to three points in a loss less than two weeks ago so i m predicting a low scoring contest on thursday night if the browns defense led by second year breakout dt mason graham keeps aaron rodgers from ever getting comfortable the upset will be in play i saw too many poor throws from deshaun watson last week to forecast such an outcome though especially with injuries leaving cleveland vulnerable on the interior of the offensive line visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.description: Whose star shines the brightest in the most highly anticipated Chiefs-Raiders game in recent memory? Which wide receiver will lead all fantasy scorers? Can the Saints provide an encore for the ages? Our analysts offer bold predictions for Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com analysts provide bold predictions spanning everything from team based takes to fantasy forecasts for week 4 of the 2026 season note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted

news_mentions.headline: Week 4 fantasy sleepers: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota, Panthers TE Darren Waller offer upside
news_mentions.description: Can Marcus Mariota thrive once again in relief of Jayden Daniels? Will Darren Waller go off against the Lions in prime time? Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 4.
news_mentions.body_text: pumpkin spice lattes scary movies and orange foliage as far as the eye can see they re all on the way it s october hard to believe we ve already completed a sixth of the nfl season it has been a wild first three weeks and they ve given way to a week 4 slate with some juicy matchups a potential international shootout a cat fight in cincinnati a battle for texas bragging rights and just as we all expected the showdown of unbeatens in las vegas for first place in the afc west there are plenty of fantasy points to be seized in such a schedule even from the most unlikely of places that s what the sleepers column is all about not all of us can have jahmyr gibbs jaxon smith njigba brock purdy and brock bowers on our rosters whether you re trying to stay unbeaten get back to 500 or notch that elusive first win of the season let s all have some fun and find some diamonds in the rough note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels (elbow) ruled out for London game; QB Marcus Mariota to start vs. Colts
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will be a bystander in London on Sunday. Washington Commanders coach Dan Quinn ruled out Daniels for Week 4’s tilt against the Indianapolis Colts.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels will be a bystander in london on sunday washington commanders coach dan quinn ruled out daniels on friday for week 4 s tilt against the indianapolis colts marcus mariota will make his second start of the season under center for washington we ll assess where we are next week when he gets a full week of practice all the way through quinn said of daniels but typical for him working incredibly hard to get back doing everything that he can behind the scenes to go do that as fast as he can he is a true competitor on and off the field daniels dislocated his non throwing elbow in a week 2 loss to the dallas cowboys the third year pro flew across the pond with the club and was a limited participant in practices this week sporting a rather large brace on his left arm daniels dismissed any worry about reinjuring the elbow which caused him to miss significant action in 2025 however the commanders aren t yet ready to throw their starter back into the fire just yet certainly anytime you can practice that s a big deal quinn said when asked how close daniels was to returning so for him to get back that was a big step for us to see what it looked like and where it would go typical for him like he s more ready than you expect so that s just kind of how he is but we ll get the whole week for him and get back at it get his elbow his body everything back right but it was really impressive to see it mariota performed well standing in for daniels last week tossing three touchdowns with zero interceptions for a 110 0 passer rating against the super bowl champion seattle seahawks in a week 3 win it marked mariota s first three td tilt since week 8 2022 with the falcons in two games one start one relief mariota is one of four qbs with four plus pass tds and zero ints in 2026 jared goff geno smith drew lock mariota and the commanders will face a colts defense that got on track in last week s 19 17 win over the houston texans but still ranks 32nd in yards allowed 417 3 and yards per play 6 5 and 30th in pass yards per game 276 0

news_mentions.headline: Dolphins rookie OL Kadyn Proctor expects heat from Vikings DC Brian Flores: 'I am the weakest link'
news_mentions.description: Brian Flores brings the heat to every offensive lineman regardless of pedigree. Dolphins rookie guard Kadyn Proctor expects the Vikings' blitz-happy defensive coordinator to target him specifically in Sunday’s bout.
news_mentions.body_text: brian flores brings the heat to every offensive lineman regardless of pedigree dolphins rookie guard kadyn proctor expects the vikings blitz happy defensive coordinator to target him specifically in sunday s bout i would say so proctor said this week via the palm beach post you know like i say i m the weakest link and you know people have attacked me up to this point but i m not scared i m not going to shy away from it so bring it flores is on a heater to open the season carrying the vikings to a 3 0 record minnesota has the second fewest total yards 715 of any team to start 3 0 since 1970 and currently owns the worst offense statistically in the nfl ranking 32nd in total yards 238 3 passing yards per game 137 yards per play 4 3 and first downs 39 yet the vikings are undefeated entering sunday because flores has bamboozled offenses the 2026 vikings have the highest blitz rate 71 1 of any team in a season since 2016 they also have the highest pressure rate 46 7 of any team in a season since 2018 per next gen stats flores defense leads the nfl with 14 sacks making minnesota the fifth team over the last 40 seasons with four plus sacks and two plus takeaways in each of its first three games of a season others 2024 vikings 2018 bears 1993 saints 1989 washington flores defenses being on that list twice now is no coincidence proctor has been solid early in his career next to left tackle patrick paul the rookie has allowed half a sack and eight qb pressures through three games including one quick pressure per next gen stats right tackle austin jackson played under flores the former dolphins coach in 2019 the veteran knows miami s offense must be ready for whatever the vikings throw at them pressure and all yeah he does do it a lot in certain situations jackson said of flores bringing extra rushers it s really situational it s really situational i would say we study as much as we can on our end but at the end of the day he could choose not to blitz us he could drop everyone make us read you never know for sure but we re just gonna study all the blitzes we can and prepare to react to whatever we get on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Mike McDaniel takes responsibility for Chargers' poor offense in 0-3 start: 'I'm not living in hope'
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles has suffered three straight losses with fewer than 45 total points scored for the first time with Justin Herbert as starting quarterback.
news_mentions.body_text: los angeles chargers coordinator mike mcdaniel isn t shying away from responsibility for the club s lack of offensive productivity in its 0 3 start i m fully responsible he said thursday via espn i spend zero time trying to avoid blame it s quite the opposite the chargers rank 30th in expected points added per play 0 21 have scored 14 7 points per game 29th in the nfl and sit 27th in turnovers with six their 44 points through three games are the fewest by the franchise since 2003 37 finished 4 12 per nfl research l a has suffered three straight losses with fewer than 45 total points scored for the first time with justin herbert as starting quarterback in week 3 the chargers offense keyed the defeat l a became the first team to lose with fewer than 25 points allowed and a 4 turnover differential or better since 2012 cardinals lost to falcons 23 19 in week 11 the buffalo defeat was the first chargers loss with at least five takeaways and fewer than 25 points allowed since week 4 1986 we were the reason we lost the football game mcdaniel said and you gotta pull your weight in this league the offense has looked as bad as the numbers suggest nothing is fluid herbert looks uncomfortable earning a career low 73 4 passer rating 30th in the nfl ahead of only drake maye and jameis winston among 32 qualified qbs the interior of the offensive line gets blasted routinely the running game is ineffective penalties are a problem there are things we ve done in the past three games that are active participation in losing the game he said and so flat out our jobs are going to prove everything and i m not living in hope i m living in reality desperately needing a victory the chargers face the defending super bowl champion seattle seahawks who come in seething after giving up 33 points in a road loss to washington last week it s going to be loud mcdaniel said they re going to be a salty team that has lost their first game in like 12 games and you know what that s just what we need an opponent that definitely is not going to feel sorry for us

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker, 49ers QB Brock Purdy highlight September Players of the Month
news_mentions.description: San Francisco quarterback Brock Purdy and Kansas City running back Kenneth Walker are among those honored in with Player of the Month accolades.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in september each month the league unveils its honor roll see who the players of the month are below afc offensive player of the month the chiefs ballyhooed free agent addition has paid immediate dividends walker blasted off with 173 rushing yards and three total touchdowns in the chiefs season opening win as kansas city has raced to a 3 0 start walker s been the offense s motor posting four scrimmage touchdowns two receiving two rushing and heads into october as the nfl s leading rusher with 360 yards nfc offensive player of the month through three games and three victories purdy has been nearly flawless purdy has sparkled to the tune of 60 of 83 passing 72 3 for 789 yards and nine touchdowns with just one interception he s also rushed for 93 yards eight first downs and a touchdown on 10 carries the 49ers 3 0 are undefeated and purdy is atop the nfl in touchdown passes tied for first and passer rating 133 1 and has yet to take a sack afc defensive player of the month every bills game so far has ended with a buffalo victory and rousseau recording two sacks rousseau has piled up 15 tackles an nfl leading eight tackles for loss three forced fumbles and a league leading six sacks which are just two off his career high for a season nfc defensive player of the month the giants are tied for first in the nfc east and holland has been a huge reason why his three interceptions are tied for the nfl lead and he s had one in each game along with a pair of forced fumbles 12 tackles and four pass breakups throw in a fumble recovery and holland s four takeaways are an nfl best afc special teams player of the month it was a perfect september for mcpherson the bengals big boot has converted each of his eight extra points and all of his eight field goal tries among those eight fgs mcpherson has made an nfl high five from 50 plus nfc special teams player of the month a day after hauling in nfc special teams player of the week price is right back for monthly honors after all he leads the nfl with 353 kick return yards and likewise leads the league with 130 punt return yards on sunday he turned in an 86 yard punt return for a touchdown thus far the only pr td in the nfl this year offensive rookie of the month what a story benson is penning through three nfl games the undrafted free agent has started each game for an undefeated chiefs squad and has now become the first lineman to win offensive rookie of the month since the colts quenton nelson in october 2018 the accolade is richly deserved benson who amazingly never played left tackle in college at indiana has allowed just seven qb pressures and one sack on 106 pass blocks 6 6 pressure rate 0 9 sack rate defensive rookie of the month in a crowded pool of defensive rookie standouts such as the commanders sonny styles and the raiders hezekiah masses the nfl s leading tackler has garnered recognition hill also has a pair of pass breakups in his three starts and has quickly developed a reputation as being a sure tackler his 5 6 missed tackle rate is seventh lowest among qualified off ball linebackers and his 12 run stops are fifth at his position per next gen stats

news_mentions.headline: Patrick Mahomes eager to face Maxx Crosby after odd offseason: Chiefs-Raiders is 'pure football'
news_mentions.description: Patrick Mahomes is back from his season-ending ACL injury and playing excellently, and edge rusher Maxx Crosby is out to ruin Mahomes' day -- and add a little trash talk on top.
news_mentions.body_text: it s been a long time since the raiders and chiefs met with identically undefeated records that s what s on deck for sunday though with 3 0 las vegas hosting 3 0 kansas city at allegiant stadium it s a matchup that is as surprising on paper as it is anticipated by both parties the contest includes two stars who will compete against each other plenty quarterback patrick mahomes is back from his season ending acl injury and playing excellently and edge rusher maxx crosby is out to ruin mahomes day and add a little trash talk on top i m here that s all i m going to have for now mahomes said wednesday when asked if he and crosby have had memorable exchanges in previous meetings i think it s just being competitors it s almost like whenever you re young and you re competing with one of your friends man you want to win because you kind of have those bragging rights and you kind of go into the offseason and if you see the guy you can kind of give him a little something here and there it s something about that it s just what the pure football is is having the best competitors compete against each other and that s what i think you really get whenever you go out there and it s raiders versus chiefs mahomes and crosby are each coming off unusually eventful offseasons for a few days in march crosby was destined to move to baltimore and become a raven baltimore s cold feet nixed that deal sending crosby back to the afc west to continue harassing mahomes the superstar quarterback meanwhile was in the midst of a long recovery from knee surgery necessitated by a december injury he actually texted me right when i got cleared to play and just kind of said hey we re both back and for me i was just kind of like let s show the world who we are mahomes said of his interaction with crosby and so i think that s just the competitors in this league there is a rivalry when we step on that field we re going to go at it that s just kind of what it is and we both know that but at the end of the day man you want the great competitors the great players in this league because it makes the league better and it makes when you go out there and do get the win even better both have had points to prove early in the 2026 season and both are riding high after three straight victories to begin the campaign they re playing great football you can see it on tape mahomes said of the raiders that 3 0 record s real they ve been playing great the entire season and so for us it s another step another challenge that we have to go up there and match by the time the clock strikes zero sunday one will no longer be perfect while the other will have a new feather in their well worn rivalry cap i just know when i step on that football field i m going to need my best because he s going to bring his best mahomes said and i think that s when you get the best games out there

news_mentions.headline: Bears' Ben Johnson won't reveal Week 4 starting QB after Keenum stunner: 'Looking at everything'
news_mentions.description: When spending his summer preparing for the 2026 season, Bears coach Ben Johnson probably didn't anticipate a quarterback conundrum.
news_mentions.body_text: when spending his summer preparing for the 2026 season bears coach ben johnson probably didn t anticipate a quarterback conundrum that s not exactly what s happening in chicago right now either but johnson spent his wednesday fielding questions regarding who will start under center for him in week 4 against the visiting jets unsurprisingly he didn t provide a firm answer we ve got three guys johnson said via the team s official site we ll work through the week and see where they re at logic and recent events would lead one to expect johnson to continue with 38 year old case keenum the 14 year veteran who propelled the bears to a 20 point win over the eagles on monday night by completing 24 of 34 passes for 247 yards and two touchdowns it s not quite that simple though keenum is listed as chicago s third string quarterback behind younger backup tyson bagent and madden nfl 27 cover star caleb williams whose week 2 hamstring injury threw the bears into uncertainty keenum was initially an afterthought too until it was revealed bagent had suffered a concussion in the week 2 loss to minnesota and was in concussion protocol keenum responded as any capable experienced veteran would stepping into the role and giving his best effort it produced stunning results helping the bears to a dominant victory and settling the concerns regarding chicago s situation under center for a week that doesn t mean johnson is necessarily going to ride the hot hand though we re looking at everything johnson said he played really well the other night sure that plays a part of the evaluation johnson has a game for which he must plan of course and determining who is handling the snaps is an important part of the process he s already completed that process the coach said wednesday he just isn t revealing who he s selected instead he s keeping that secret as a competitive advantage in the meantime folks outside halas hall can spend the week reviewing what s occurred and conclude it s especially helpful to have three competent quarterbacks on a roster johnson would agree it s not hard for me at all he said i feel really good about all three quarterbacks in that room and i know all three of them can win ballgames for us

news_mentions.headline: Patriots' Drake Maye: Shoulder not impacting throws; no rift with HC Mike Vrabel
news_mentions.description: Patriots QB Drake Maye told reporters that his right shoulder, which appeared on Wednesday's injury report, is not impacting how he's throwing the ball.
news_mentions.body_text: trouble in paradise now includes a health concern for drake maye the quarterback landed on new england s wednesday injury report with a right shoulder injury but was a full participant in the day s practice maye was asked on wednesday if his shoulder is impacting how he s throwing the football no it hasn t maye said i don t think it impacts my decision making and that s what makes and breaks play for quarterbacks maye instead redirected the attention toward the team s turnover issues which he admitted are holding them back that s this position there are reps in the game and there are ones that cost you maye explained it happens to be that you ve got to outweigh the good with the bad by a wide margin to play well at this position and that s quarterback i m feeling good throwing and i feel like i have some throws i wish i had back as i always do and definitely some decisions but at the same time i ve got to trust my guys and trust the guys up front they re doing a nice job to keep on playing football coach mike vrabel didn t appear to be concerned with his quarterback s status when speaking with reporters prior to wednesday s practice but did have to answer questions regarding a local report from weei s greg hill that suggested there is friction between vrabel and maye he heard from who unnamed sources let me just tell you why i m here vrabel said i m here because drake was the quarterback believe it or not i had choices as to where i wanted to coach i wanted to coach here because drake was the quarterback so i don t have really much other to add to that about a comment from an unnamed source but i ll just tell you what i ve told numerous people if they want to ask me why i m here after three weeks new england is 1 2 but occupies a place that seems much more nightmarish than the team s record might suggest maye has played a major role in their difficulties creating space for the locals to sow discord maye has struggled significantly to start the 2026 season throwing three interceptions in the season s kickoff game a 13 10 loss to seattle and committing seven giveaways in three contests in new england s lopsided 35 6 defeat in jacksonville on sunday maye accounted for all three patriots turnovers including a couple of ghastly interceptions and a fumble in which the ball slipped out of his hand as he was winding to throw his numbers have fallen accordingly after throwing for 4 394 yards and posting a 31 8 td int ratio in 2025 production worthy of an nfl mvp finalist spot maye has completed 63 8 percent of his passes for 585 yards and a 1 6 td int ratio in 2026 his passer rating has dropped by 54 9 points the largest decrease from one season to the next among qualifying quarterbacks in the super bowl era per nfl research at one point during sunday s loss patriots color commentator scott zolak suggested vrabel might bench maye for backup tommy devito it eventually happened in the fourth quarter but only because the game was out of reach afterward vrabel expressed his concern level is very high for this football team an accurate assessment of the defending afc champions who have looked nothing like it through three weeks that doesn t mean vrabel is suddenly at odds with his quarterback coach vrabel s been one of the best football coaches i ve had in my life maye said on wednesday when asked of the reported rift i think coach vrabel s been one of the biggest things as to why this has been so enjoyable for me is playing for coach i think we all feel that way in the locker room he pushes us hard i ve loved playing for him and it s not going to change it hasn t changed and it won t change the way he pushes me and he coaches the quarterbacks in a way that i really respect and i m looking forward to getting going proving to coach that i can lead this football team and play good football instead of spending his days refuting reports of internal conflict vrabel is dedicating himself to helping his quarterback improve it s essential to the patriots efforts of repeating as afc east champions ahead of a big week 4 game at the 3 0 bills on sunday well the same thing i ve been doing just trying to coach the football team trying to coach him vrabel said when asked how he could help maye climb out of his slump i m not going to coach him the x s and o s i mean i can show him the defense and say hey this is what these guys may like to try to do but it s just about the urgency that we have how we operate and how we get in and out of the huddle and the command of the huddle the quarterback is a conduit to offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and the play caller i firmly believe that the way that they tell the players that they re playing with like hey this is what we re going to do this play is going to work not because it s some great scheme it s going to work because we re going to execute it or we re going to make it work and you get them to believe that whatever he calls is going to be successful now will every one be no that s not how it goes but that s what i try to teach them each and every day maye s partnership with mcdaniels worked wonderfully in 2025 en route to a surprising super bowl trip making their struggles that much more shocking it s early though and as vrabel said if maye can eliminate his negative plays their issues will eventually dissipate just don t expect him to say much more about a rumored conflict

news_mentions.headline: Rams head coach Sean McVay: WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to return for Rams Sunday vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams expect wide receiver Puka Nacua to play in Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles after missing the team's last two games with a hip/groin injury.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams are ready to welcome back a major piece of their offense los angeles expects receiver puka nacua to play in sunday s game against the philadelphia eagles coach sean mcvay told reporters wednesday nacua was officially a limited participant in wednesday s practice a sign that he s nearing a return defensive tackle aaron donald meanwhile did not practice to back soreness per mcvay nacua has been battling a hip and groin injury related to his psoas since training camp inspiring concern he might be headed for surgery at some point in 2026 he managed to suit up for the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in melbourne australia in week 1 catching five passes for 74 yards but he s since been sidelined missing the rams last two games without nacua quarterback matthew stafford has leaned heavily on fellow veteran davante adams connecting with the three time all pro 15 times for 332 yards and two touchdowns in the last two weeks the production has been plentiful but without nacua it s also caused the rams to become a bit more predictable especially in the second half of the rams week 3 loss to denver underscoring their need for nacua s return it sounds as if that will happen sunday against an eagles team that is reeling from a lopsided loss to the chicago bears in which 38 year old quarterback case keenum threw for 247 yards and two touchdowns if nacua can fit back into the offense quickly stafford could be in line for an even more prolific afternoon

news_mentions.headline: Titans HC Robert Saleh: Cam Ward has 'some PTSD' from number of sacks in rookie season
news_mentions.description: The Titans offense has struggled to start the season. Head coach Robert Saleh attributed some of Robert Saleh's struggles to "some PTSD" from the number of sacks he endured during his rookie season.
news_mentions.body_text: the tennessee titans offense has lived in strugglesville through three games to start the 2026 season with second year qb cam ward leading an inefficient operation in week 3 s 12 7 loss to the new york giants tennessee began with five straight three and out drives and managed a meager 54 yards of total offense in the first half the titans got back in the game late with three lengthy drives in the third and fourth quarters but ward s forced game sealing interception in the final seconds led the club to 0 3 first year titans head coach robert saleh was asked wednesday about the qb s struggles you ve got to remember the young man was sacked however many times last year so i m sure there s some ptsd there saleh said but he s getting better he s trusting it his footwork is lasting him longer into games if that makes sense but from an accuracy standpoint decision making standpoint everything starts with your feet at the quarterback position ward took 55 sacks in 2025 tied for the league lead with geno smith of the las vegas raiders saleh noted that ward s mechanics come and go within contests you see him comfortable in the pocket he said on wednesday you see him trusting the offensive line and later in the game you kind of see him kind of revert back to some old habits but i do think he s getting better in that regard i think he s starting to really appreciate the offensive line because i think they are doing a really good job protecting him ward is a streaky passer when he s in rhythm and he reads the defense properly the titans offense moves sunday s game was an example of both the bad and good in the first half ward never found a rhythm and was off a smidge on several throws in the second half as he trusted his protection more he released some on target lasers for now this is who ward is a rollercoaster qb the game losing int was an example of a still young player trying to make a play he should have tossed it away and lived for another down that s the sort of mistake the second year qb must weed out of his game i just don t think i played my best in critical situations ward said on wednesday when i need to play my best i didn t that s something i gotta get better at that s something i need to attack this week and going into the next game with baltimore and houston on tap next saleh must hope ward makes those strides quickly i think we re going to eventually get to a point where he s not even thinking twice and none of us are even talking about this anymore saleh said he is working relentlessly i know oc brian daboll and his staff work relentlessly with him to make sure that he s being shown where he can be better and where he s been good and we ll just keep getting better at it

news_mentions.headline: 20th anniversary of Superdome reopening: Revisiting key moments from Saints' emotional win over Falcons
news_mentions.description: During Monday night's rivalry game against Atlanta, New Orleans will celebrate the 20th anniversary of the Superdome's reopening following Hurricane Katrina. Nick Shook looks back at key moments from the Saints' emotional win over the Falcons on Sept. 25, 2006.
news_mentions.body_text: monday s prime time showdown between the atlanta falcons and new orleans saints is not just the latest edition of one of the nfl s most heated rivalries though plenty will be on the line in the week 4 finale it s the 20th anniversary of one of the most meaningful nights in league history when the falcons and saints kick off monday night football in new orleans it will be 20 years and 10 days since the superdome reopened following hurricane katrina on that night sept 25 2006 atlanta and new orleans met in a nationally televised contest also on espn that was the saints first game at the superdome since dec 26 2004 it was a home opener yes but much more than that it represented a welcome return to normalcy for a city that had been out of sorts for more than a year during the 2005 season the saints played home games at giants stadium in new jersey the alamodome in san antonio and tiger stadium in baton rouge louisiana as the superdome underwent a 10 month restoration to fix damage caused by hurricane katrina week 3 s contest against the nfc south rival falcons marked the saints return to the comfy confines that had been repaired and refurbished in record time plenty of reconstruction was left to complete throughout the city new orleans was still fighting to get back on its feet but finally after a devastating weather event changed their lives forever new orleanians had something to cheer for and as they saw it they had a message of revival to deliver to the rest of the nation new coach sean payton ensured his players understood the gravity of the moment holding their thursday night practice in the superdome and delivering a speech that resonated throughout the organization look it s going to be a special night but it s only going to be special if we win payton told them as he recalled in timeline rebirth in new orleans if we lose it s just another football game so i want you to go home and get ready to come back here and kick some a that night in that building i think was the first time we felt pressure former saints linebacker scott fujita recalled because that s when you recognized how big this thing was the homecoming or rather domecoming was an achievement in itself so too was the 23 3 triumph over the falcons earned in front of dignitaries from the football world longtime nfl commissioner paul tagliabue and his successor roger goodell and beyond former president george h w bush handled the coin toss after a pregame concert performed by green day and u2 as many who were there that night have recounted the energy mirrored that of a super bowl with meaning that stretched far beyond simple athletic competition i vividly remember looking across the field and seeing the falcons and looking up at the crowd in the dome and thinking it was impossible for us to lose tonight former saints safety steve gleason said in timeline rebirth in new orleans with another falcons saints showdown in the big easy approaching let s take a look back at some of the highlights from that legendary night beginning with one of the most iconic plays in saints history steve gleason s blocked punt it s the play that inspired a statue and delivered the surge of life new orleans needed to officially christen the city s rebirth it s also the play that defined one man s playing career and the battle he s faced in retirement against als new orleans forced a three and out on atlanta s first possession of the game prompting the falcons to send out michael koenen to punt gleason the fan favorite and saints special teams captain led the punt return unit onto the field he identified the perfect look to execute payton s punt block stunting from one a gap to the other upon the snap and sprinting through untouched diving with outstretched arms to block koenen s punt as the sound of koenen s punt hitting gleason s gloved hands traveled through the air the superdome erupted fellow special teamer curtis deloatch was first to arrive at the live ball falling on it in the end zone for the saints first score at the superdome in more than a year it was like a shotgun blast saints icon drew brees said in timeline rebirth in new orleans i ve to this day never heard a sound more meaningful than that football hitting steve gleason s hands when he blocked it that s what that moment became known as the rebirth of new orleans fujita said saints score again on trick play td if gleason s blocked punt and deloatch s recovery for a touchdown weren t fitting enough for the momentous occasion an even stronger louisiana connection found the end zone for the saints later in the first quarter with new orleans at atlanta s 11 yard line and threatening to widen their lead payton decided it was time to take a creative risk in his first home game as saints coach payton dialed up some trickery calling for a double reverse that included brees reggie bush and lsu product devery henderson required brees to make a courageous lead block and ended with henderson in the end zone espn play by play commentator mike tirico made sure to shout out henderson s lsu background where he was part of another memorable play in louisiana lore known as the bluegrass miracle and finish the call with touchdown new orleans signifying this was much more than just another prime time football game special teams blocks another kick the third phase heroics didn t end with gleason s punt block holding a 17 3 lead shortly before halftime the saints defense bowed up in the shadow of their own goal post preventing the falcons from reaching the end zone and forcing them to settle for a chip shot field goal except most chip shots don t include intentional obstructions with 1 54 remaining in the second quarter eventual pro football hall of famer morten andersen lined up for a 25 yard field goal from the right hash as the snap fired back to the atlanta holder saints defensive back josh bullocks knifed through the falcons line gaining unrestricted entry into the backfield and throwing both arms into the air his right arm connected with andersen s angled kick denying the falcons a scoring opportunity and standing as the saints second special teams block of the night saints swallow up michael vick vick entered the game as the face of atlanta s franchise and the foil to new orleans special night he left as the roughed up target of the saints aggression new orleans sacked vick five times on the night for a combined loss of 25 yards with three of the quarterback takedowns coming in the fourth quarter the saints penultimate sack saw new orleans dial up an interior twist freeing defensive tackle brian young whose pursuit of vick forced the quarterback to duck in order to slip his tackle attempt waiting on the other end of vick s evasive maneuver was charles grant who fought through a holding penalty on right tackle todd weiner to take down vick the game was essentially already over by that point with the saints leading 23 3 halfway through the final period but the unrelenting effort really summed up new orleans inspired performance on a truly inspiring night

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the San Francisco 49ers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the san francisco 49ers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location sap performance facility santa clara california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs denver broncos 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at las vegas raiders 4 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs los angeles chargers 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note san francisco doesn t face a team that made the 2024 playoffs in the final eight weeks of the upcoming season nfl research what you need to know 1 after a four year sojourn in jersey as the new york jets head coach robert saleh has returned to the bay as defensive coordinator but his house isn t as he left it the 49ers were fifth in yards allowed and 17th in points in 2020 saleh s last with the squad in 2024 they were still eighth in yards but an awful 29th in points given up san francisco underwent myriad roster changes with plenty of departures on the defensive side dre greenlaw talanoa hufanga and charvarius ward among them the cupboard is hardly bare though as saleh can rely on dominant mainstays nick bosa and fred warner among the big questions to be answered this summer is how his ex jets pass rusher bryce huff acclimates out west after a trying 2024 with the philadelphia eagles and how fast no 11 overall pick mykel williams gets going there are plenty more quandaries for saleh to address though williams is likely to be among three rookie starters along with defensive tackle alfred collins and linebacker nick martin and the 49ers produced just 37 sacks a season ago tied for 23rd in the nfl saleh s got plenty of reconstruction at hand amid his return 2 unlike last summer christian mccaffrey is set for training camp and set to be all systems go originally thought to be precautionary mccaffrey missed camp last year with an achilles and calf injury that extended to him missing the first eight games of the season after finally getting back on the field mccaffrey s campaign concluded with a pcl injury in total he played only four games during a disastrous 2024 season cmc has proclaimed himself healthy from his pcl and had no restrictions during offseason workouts his health will remain a concern though it s a given following the third season in his eight year career in which he played seven games or less due to injury the coming weeks will also be worth seeing if mccaffrey 29 resembles his 2023 rushing champion self since he was traded from the panthers whom he s slated to face for the first time in week 12 to the 49ers mccaffrey has propelled san francisco to a 23 8 record when he s on the field the niners are 8 12 without him plain and simple mccaffrey is one of the nfl s elite when he s healthful and so are the 49ers 3 finally the 49ers were in line for a drama less training camp then reports surfaced that wide receiver jauan jennings was disenchanted with his contract a two year 15 39 million pact signed in the spring of 2024 brock purdy george kittle and fred warner each worked out lengthy and lucrative new deals already in a stark contrast from past offseasons when brandon aiyuk and trent williams 2024 nick bosa 2023 and deebo samuel 2022 had dilemmas dominate summer headlines just how large jennings contract dismay looms over camp remains to be seen regardless it illuminates an already existing concern for the 49ers their wide receiver corps samuel was one of plenty notable departures for the team the wideback s trade to washington coupled with aiyuk s recovery from a 2024 knee injury put the position in question jennings stepped up and into the wr1 role last season and will likely get tabbed as such again but there s now a wrinkle to those best laid plans 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall has a big camp ahead and a larger role to take after that ex los angeles ram demarcus robinson second year wideout jacob cowing and rookies jordan watkins and junior bergen will be vying to make contributions
