news_mentions.description: Who'll own first place in the AFC North after tonight's showdown between the Steelers and Browns? Will the Chiefs or Raiders take Sunday's rivalry bout between undefeated AFC West teams? Can the Rams exorcise their Eagles demons? Check out the Week 4 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 4 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday oct 1 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 4 why jeremy picked the commanders with or without jayden daniels washington has a chance to give the colts fits in london jonathan taylor indy s main outlet for offensive production over the years is facing a commanders run defense that ranks third in the nfl through three weeks taylor is an international legend after last year s blistering berlin showing but he hasn t broken 100 yards in a game this season washington has been careful with the ball on offense committing just one giveaway all year while the colts defense has been among the league s worst in terms of yards and points allowed but also takeaways 1 both clubs are turning a corner after getting off the schneid in week 3 but the commanders are in a better place even with their starting quarterback rehabbing another dislocated elbow editor s update washington coach dan quinn announced on friday that jayden daniels has been ruled out of sunday s game veteran qb marcus mariota will make his second straight start after leading the commanders to a 33 31 upset win over the seahawks why jeremy picked the ravens derrick henry s first meeting with his former team isn t necessarily a revenge game after all he left the titans in 2024 as they downsized and little of the regime that shipped him out remains that fact won t stop henry from trying to run all over tennessee on sunday afternoon history however may be against henry no player has ever rushed for at least 100 yards against a team with which he recorded at least 9 000 career rushing yards plus the titans for all their faults in this season s early going have been competitive against the run allowing just 3 6 yards per attempt when henry plows into the teeth of the titans front on sunday jeffery simmons has vowed to hit his ass tennessee s main issue remains cam ward the offense and its slow starts the titans should expect no relief against a ravens outfit rejuvenated by its resounding win in rio why gennaro picked the bills what is the best representation of new england s well documented offensive struggles i m partial to one simple statistic that has made the rounds this week in 30 offensive drives this season the patriots have scored 29 points for comparison s sake the bills have logged 32 offensive drives and scored 101 points another painful pats stat that s burning up the interwebs going back to january s playoffs drake maye has turned the ball over 15 times in his past seven games what on earth has happened to last season s mvp runner up the 24 year old s putrid play has spawned theories far and wide some more conspiratorial than others is cover 6 his kryptonite is the shoulder still barking from last season s injury is there a rift between maye and mike vrabel i won t pretend to have any of those answers but one thing is pretty easy to surmise the quarterback misses a j brown unfortunately the blockbuster trade acquisition s high ankle sprain is expected to keep him out until late october and in the here and now new england s other notable offseason addition out wide romeo doubs has gotten off to a rough start in foxborough if maye and co are indeed suffering the infamous super bowl hangover it s hard to believe the best remedy is a trip to buffalo for a game against their undefeated division rivals why brooke picked the bears will the bears start case keenum or tyson bagent at quarterback that s the question ben johnson must weigh the veteran diced up the eagles on monday night but the hc insists there are reasons bagent ended camp as qb2 we ll find out soon enough but no matter the jets have held a lead or been tied in the fourth quarter of all three games but i don t see that to be the case sunday after myriad injuries to key jets including rb breece hall wr adonai mitchell te mason taylor og dylan parham all are week to week per hc aaron glenn the offense faces an uphill climb especially with its bell cow back sidelined against a bears d that has held its last two opponents to fewer than 10 points new york s defense has impressed and made plays to be sure it s good enough to make stops but can it make enough stops to help its undermanned offense keep pace a competitive game gets away from gang green late with the league s top ranked rushing attack running out the clock to give chicago its second straight win at soldier field why bobby picked the jaguars after two superb weeks for cincy s defense bengals fans must have been having flashbacks to recent seasons as their team was suddenly unable to slow down the steelers aaron rodgers threw for over 290 yards and three touchdowns for the first time since he was a packer in 2021 and jaylen warren went off for 176 yards from scrimmage it s just one game but the result also necessitates looking back at the first two weeks that caused cincinnati to earn praise for a supposed offseason transformation the four takeaways against tampa bay in week 1 were great but the bengals still gave up points to an offense that has since struggled and after doing nothing against cincinnati in week 2 houston was just quieted by a colts team that had allowed the second most yards through the first two games in a season in nfl history now the jaguars come to town with the most high functioning offense the bengals have faced thus far by a wide margin they just blew the doors off the reigning afc champions defeating the patriots 35 6 trevor lawrence enters the contest playing well with 616 passing yards seven touchdowns two picks and a 107 8 passer rating if the bengals prove unable to limit the damage again defensively joe burrow and co will have a mighty tough task keeping up against the no 1 defense in points allowed why brooke picked the cowboys the battle for texas is back with both teams aiming to avoid their worst starts since 2020 in two career games against the texans dak prescott has struggled with a 61 8 completion percentage 2 4 td to int ratio and a 69 0 passer rating and he s yet face a demeco ryans led unit with houston or san francisco so things could continue to go south i m a big believer in the texans defense but think the cowboys are too talented an offense to lay down this early in the season that said brian schottenheimer must coach smarter this week and there are major concerns with that defense which continues to get hit with the injury bug it ll be without dt jonathan bullard s jalen thompson and potentially cb shavon revel this week after losing cb cobie durant s p j locke lb demarvion overshown and s malik hooker in weeks prior the cowboys made a trade wednesday night for disgruntled pittsburgh corner joey porter which should aid the waning secondary once he s on the field the saving grace for that unit right now though is that the texans offense has been abysmal scoring a total of 23 points in the last two games notably no 1 receiver nico collins returned to practice wednesday but can his presence alone make all the difference for c j stroud and houston s floundering offense it s definitely possible and i won t be all that shocked if collins spurs the texans to victory but on the whole i ve seen a bit more from dallas at this juncture why jeremy picked the cardinals it s a rivalry renewed in the meadowlands oh you don t remember the old divisional clashes between big blue and the chicago st louis phoenix arizona cardinals well then you surely don t recall that the giants have never beaten the cards in metlife stadium and haven t won against these birds at home since week 1 of 2005 in the kurt warner bowl it s been a while for the g men but will the stain of that two decade long failure play into sunday s showdown the more pressing elements in the game will be whether jameis winston can finally get the giants in the end zone against a cards defense that was exploited by the nfc west elite in weeks 2 and 3 and whether a giants defense sans brian burns can pressure jacoby brissett and co into critical errors at this point in the season i have more faith in the steady brissett and mike lafleur s overachieving cards team than a new york outfit making desperate september trades to stabilize a roster depleted of star power oh yeah and arizona doesn t lose at metlife math why gennaro picked the eagles last sunday night los angeles blew a 16 0 halftime lead at denver to drop back below 500 in a season that began with the rams as prohibitive super bowl favorites one night later philadelphia was blown out of chicago by a bears team that was forced to give case keenum his first start in 1 009 days so after a pair of nationally televised debacles who s in better position to bounce back well the expected return of star wr puka nacua is certainly a boon to sean mcvay s squad but can the rams coach exorcise his demons against the eagles mcvay is 1 6 vs philadelphia having dropped all four matchups against nick sirianni last season s loss at lincoln financial field was particularly painful not only did the rams blow a 19 point third quarter lead but they had two fourth quarter field goal attempts blocked including a would be game winner from 44 yards out on the last snap of the contest in addition to swatting that final kick hulking dt jordan davis memorably scooped up the ball and galloped for an exclamation point touchdown but the big man s triumphant rumble was easily the eagles best run of the day as the rams held saquon barkley to just 55 total yards on 22 touches that was a huge departure from barkley s previous two games against l a when he piled up 534 scrimmage yards philly s had trouble getting a consistent ground attack going under new oc sean mannion but barkley did enjoy success against chicago this past monday night before the game got out of hand potentially signaling a schematic breakthrough in a matchup between two established powers that have yet to play up to their talent level this season i m far from bullish on the eagles but i anticipate sirianni will rally the troops once again versus mcvay with the birds feeling disrespected as home underdogs why bobby picked the buccaneers once upon a time undrafted rookie tommy devito led the giants to a shocking upset over the packers rushing for 71 yards while throwing for another 158 and a touchdown that was against a 2023 version of green bay playing far better than a packers squad currently in full blown crisis mode with baker mayfield out several weeks due to a dislocated thumb undrafted rookie jalon daniels who impressed enough in preseason to win the backup job has a chance to pen a similar story daniels finding a way to spark tampa bay s struggling offense isn t as farfetched as it might seem that s not to say he s the quarterback mayfield is but baker currently sits dead last among qualified quarterbacks with a 35 6 expected points added per nfl pro the bar for daniels to surpass what the 2026 version of mayfield did through three games is not remotely high and everyone saw what michael penix achieved against the packers d during his first game back since tearing his acl on nov 16 last season green bay s thursday night debacle didn t portray its offense in any more of a positive light the offensive line is swiss cheese allowing the quickest average time to pressure 2 29 and struggling to forge a path for the league s worst rushing attack which has managed 146 yards in three games do the patchwork signings of mekhi becton laken tomlinson and kevin zeitler change that not nearly soon enough which could lead to the bucs first win of the season why bobby picked the vikings generally a good rule of thumb is to go with the 3 0 team over the 0 3 one minnesota would be the correct pick regardless of records though the vikings offense which currently sits last in the league in yards should be in line for a reprieve against a porous miami squad the fins rank 28th in points allowed through three weeks and their 0 15 expected points added per play allowed is tied with the colts for worst in the league per nfl pro there might be some concerns moving forward if kyler murray and the offense don t fully wake up against miami but it shouldn t affect this particular result that s because minnesota s dominant defense is set to feast on the dolphins struggling offense which just lost its best player de 39 von achane to a season ending acl tear miami has yet to score more than 13 points this season while the vikings are allowing an average of 13 7 brian flores will ensure the dolphins don t have an easy time trying to buck those trends the most daring defensive coordinator in the league boasts a blitz rate of 68 1 24 2 higher than the second most blitz happy team malik willis enters week 4 tied for the fourth worst completion percentage 50 against blitzes and now he must face the purple porpoise eaters i know dolphins aren t porpoises allow me the alliteration why brooke picked the raiders two of the five remaining undefeateds reside in the afc west and who thought the raiders would be one put your hand down they face their toughest opponent to date in the chiefs whose offense continues to steadily improve with eric bieniemy back as oc see a much improved run game led by the nfl s leading rusher kenneth walker with patrick mahomes leveling back up to his mvp caliber standards and whose defense is a top five overall and scoring unit i believe these raiders are up for the challenge kirk cousins is jibing with klint kubiak s scheme throwing three tds in each game this season and plays well against man coverage which steve spagnuolo s defense runs on 37 6 percent of dropbacks fifth most in the nfl per next gen stats cousins has six pass tds zero ints and a 126 2 passer rating vs man this season while recording three pass tds three ints and an 85 2 passer rating vs zone coverage cousins has time to deal with the way his o line is playing five sacks allowed through three games but the raiders need week 3 afc offensive player of the week brock bowers and ashton jeanty to show up in a big way las vegas leads the league with a 5 turnover differential and defensively the team is tied for fourth in sacks but the raiders must limit walker that s a huge key to this game this is the most inspiring the raiders have looked in eons and though the chiefs might be the more experienced of the two vegas newfound confidence and the energy the black hole will bring to allegiant stadium on sunday will be just enough to eke out a w giving the franchise more wins heading into week 5 than it managed in the entire 2025 season why bobby picked the seahawks the seahawks week 3 loss to the commanders was their first since nov 16 of 2025 when they square off against the chargers they will have suffered just two defeats in the previous 365 days it was shocking to see them falter against a formerly winless washington team led by backup quarterback marcus mariota but that s easy enough to wave away as any given sunday these chargers it s impossible to dismiss all that plagues them they re so offensively challenged that even with the bills turning it over five times they only managed 16 points in their recent loss to buffalo and that was the most los angeles has scored all season regardless of one takeaway filled day the chargers defense isn t performing up to its typical stellar standard the unit currently ranks 20th in points allowed down from ninth in 2025 and first in 2024 the struggles have even carried over to pro bowl kicker cameron dicker who has missed a field goal attempt in each of the last two outings the chargers will be desperate to turn it around sunday and start salvaging their season but the seahawks a much better team will also likely play with a little extra fire coming off such a jaw dropping loss why dan picked the 49ers i d like to see the broncos play a complete game before i predict them to go on the road and defeat the team that s arguably been the best in football through three weeks denver is 2 1 but it s been outscored 40 10 in the first halves of its first three games the concerningly slow starts are not lost on head coach sean payton who said this week that trying to play catch up will cost us in bigger games sunday s matchup feels like it could be one of those featuring two squads with legitimate super bowl aspirations the broncos have already proven they can come back against the league s better teams doing so at home versus the jaguars and rams in consecutive weeks but now they re the visitors against the undefeated 49ers who must be feeling pretty comfy as they prepare for their third consecutive game at levi s stadium a scheduling quirk for a club that opened the season in australia brock purdy is playing at an elite level even with injuries once again plaguing san francisco s receiving corps and kyle shanahan is on a coaching heater dating back to last season it won t come easy but i m expecting the niners to be 4 0 entering week 5 for the first time since 2023 why gennaro picked the lions three weeks into the season detroit ranks near the bottom of the nfl in most defensive categories fortunately the lions continue to field one of the league s most potent offenses having scored exactly 31 points in all three games how will the panthers look to counter defensively that s a good question after all ejiro evero s unit ranks dead last in run defense giving up a bountiful 5 7 yards per carry more than half a yard worse than any other team good luck containing jahmyr gibbs does carolina at least have the horses to keep up with amon ra st brown and jameson williams in the passing game not anymore star cb1 jaycee horn and underrated cb2 mike jackson just hit injured reserve now one thing that could help the panthers slow down the lions is the outdoor environment at bank of america stadium not only is detroit a dome team but at publishing it looks like this could be a rainy weekend in charlotte then again if precipitation ultimately plays a role on sunday night carolina might not be able to take full advantage of detroit s disastrous secondary the panthers should put some points on the board but i ll be surprised if they keep up with the lions posse of playmakers monday oct 5 why dan picked the saints new orleans is a few plays away from being 3 0 right now i can t say the same for the falcons although the rout of a lost green bay team in michael penix s 2026 debut was highly encouraging the saints have the smallest margin of defeat 4 5 among the 16 teams with multiple losses entering week 4 and they beat themselves last sunday turning the ball over on all four of their possessions in the fourth quarter against the raiders i m expecting a cleaner performance from tyler shough who ranks second in the league in passing yards 917 and is tied for third in touchdown passes 8 entering week 4 jeff ulbrich has atlanta s defense playing inspired ball even with injuries to key players but kellen moore s group should provide the stiffest test it s faced so far the superdome crowd always brings the energy and the vibes will likely be off the charts on monday night as the saints celebrate the 20th anniversary of one of the most iconic games in franchise history give me the home team in a tight one thursday s game why dan picked the steelers i know the recent history of the steelers trips to cleveland it s the stuff of nightmares for pittsburgh but i m not ready to trust the browns offense it ranks among the bottom five units in too many categories including total yards third down conversion rate and red zone touchdown percentage now i m certainly not convinced the steelers are a finely tuned offensive machine either even after their 30 point outburst against the bengals mike mccarthy s crew was held to three points in a loss less than two weeks ago so i m predicting a low scoring contest on thursday night if the browns defense led by second year breakout dt mason graham keeps aaron rodgers from ever getting comfortable the upset will be in play i saw too many poor throws from deshaun watson last week to forecast such an outcome though especially with injuries leaving cleveland vulnerable on the interior of the offensive line visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 4 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Who'll own first place in the AFC North after tonight's showdown between the Steelers and Browns? Will the Chiefs or Raiders take Sunday's rivalry bout between undefeated AFC West teams? Can the Rams exorcise their Eagles demons? Check out the Week 4 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 4 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday oct 1 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday oct 4 why jeremy picked the commanders with or without jayden daniels washington has a chance to give the colts fits in london jonathan taylor indy s main outlet for offensive production over the years is facing a commanders run defense that ranks third in the nfl through three weeks taylor is an international legend after last year s blistering berlin showing but he hasn t broken 100 yards in a game this season washington has been careful with the ball on offense committing just one giveaway all year while the colts defense has been among the league s worst in terms of yards and points allowed but also takeaways 1 both clubs are turning a corner after getting off the schneid in week 3 but the commanders are in a better place even with their starting quarterback rehabbing another dislocated elbow editor s update washington coach dan quinn announced on friday that jayden daniels has been ruled out of sunday s game veteran qb marcus mariota will make his second straight start after leading the commanders to a 33 31 upset win over the seahawks why jeremy picked the ravens derrick henry s first meeting with his former team isn t necessarily a revenge game after all he left the titans in 2024 as they downsized and little of the regime that shipped him out remains that fact won t stop henry from trying to run all over tennessee on sunday afternoon history however may be against henry no player has ever rushed for at least 100 yards against a team with which he recorded at least 9 000 career rushing yards plus the titans for all their faults in this season s early going have been competitive against the run allowing just 3 6 yards per attempt when henry plows into the teeth of the titans front on sunday jeffery simmons has vowed to hit his ass tennessee s main issue remains cam ward the offense and its slow starts the titans should expect no relief against a ravens outfit rejuvenated by its resounding win in rio why gennaro picked the bills what is the best representation of new england s well documented offensive struggles i m partial to one simple statistic that has made the rounds this week in 30 offensive drives this season the patriots have scored 29 points for comparison s sake the bills have logged 32 offensive drives and scored 101 points another painful pats stat that s burning up the interwebs going back to january s playoffs drake maye has turned the ball over 15 times in his past seven games what on earth has happened to last season s mvp runner up the 24 year old s putrid play has spawned theories far and wide some more conspiratorial than others is cover 6 his kryptonite is the shoulder still barking from last season s injury is there a rift between maye and mike vrabel i won t pretend to have any of those answers but one thing is pretty easy to surmise the quarterback misses a j brown unfortunately the blockbuster trade acquisition s high ankle sprain is expected to keep him out until late october and in the here and now new england s other notable offseason addition out wide romeo doubs has gotten off to a rough start in foxborough if maye and co are indeed suffering the infamous super bowl hangover it s hard to believe the best remedy is a trip to buffalo for a game against their undefeated division rivals why brooke picked the bears will the bears start case keenum or tyson bagent at quarterback that s the question ben johnson must weigh the veteran diced up the eagles on monday night but the hc insists there are reasons bagent ended camp as qb2 we ll find out soon enough but no matter the jets have held a lead or been tied in the fourth quarter of all three games but i don t see that to be the case sunday after myriad injuries to key jets including rb breece hall wr adonai mitchell te mason taylor og dylan parham all are week to week per hc aaron glenn the offense faces an uphill climb especially with its bell cow back sidelined against a bears d that has held its last two opponents to fewer than 10 points new york s defense has impressed and made plays to be sure it s good enough to make stops but can it make enough stops to help its undermanned offense keep pace a competitive game gets away from gang green late with the league s top ranked rushing attack running out the clock to give chicago its second straight win at soldier field why bobby picked the jaguars after two superb weeks for cincy s defense bengals fans must have been having flashbacks to recent seasons as their team was suddenly unable to slow down the steelers aaron rodgers threw for over 290 yards and three touchdowns for the first time since he was a packer in 2021 and jaylen warren went off for 176 yards from scrimmage it s just one game but the result also necessitates looking back at the first two weeks that caused cincinnati to earn praise for a supposed offseason transformation the four takeaways against tampa bay in week 1 were great but the bengals still gave up points to an offense that has since struggled and after doing nothing against cincinnati in week 2 houston was just quieted by a colts team that had allowed the second most yards through the first two games in a season in nfl history now the jaguars come to town with the most high functioning offense the bengals have faced thus far by a wide margin they just blew the doors off the reigning afc champions defeating the patriots 35 6 trevor lawrence enters the contest playing well with 616 passing yards seven touchdowns two picks and a 107 8 passer rating if the bengals prove unable to limit the damage again defensively joe burrow and co will have a mighty tough task keeping up against the no 1 defense in points allowed why brooke picked the cowboys the battle for texas is back with both teams aiming to avoid their worst starts since 2020 in two career games against the texans dak prescott has struggled with a 61 8 completion percentage 2 4 td to int ratio and a 69 0 passer rating and he s yet face a demeco ryans led unit with houston or san francisco so things could continue to go south i m a big believer in the texans defense but think the cowboys are too talented an offense to lay down this early in the season that said brian schottenheimer must coach smarter this week and there are major concerns with that defense which continues to get hit with the injury bug it ll be without dt jonathan bullard s jalen thompson and potentially cb shavon revel this week after losing cb cobie durant s p j locke lb demarvion overshown and s malik hooker in weeks prior the cowboys made a trade wednesday night for disgruntled pittsburgh corner joey porter which should aid the waning secondary once he s on the field the saving grace for that unit right now though is that the texans offense has been abysmal scoring a total of 23 points in the last two games notably no 1 receiver nico collins returned to practice wednesday but can his presence alone make all the difference for c j stroud and houston s floundering offense it s definitely possible and i won t be all that shocked if collins spurs the texans to victory but on the whole i ve seen a bit more from dallas at this juncture why jeremy picked the cardinals it s a rivalry renewed in the meadowlands oh you don t remember the old divisional clashes between big blue and the chicago st louis phoenix arizona cardinals well then you surely don t recall that the giants have never beaten the cards in metlife stadium and haven t won against these birds at home since week 1 of 2005 in the kurt warner bowl it s been a while for the g men but will the stain of that two decade long failure play into sunday s showdown the more pressing elements in the game will be whether jameis winston can finally get the giants in the end zone against a cards defense that was exploited by the nfc west elite in weeks 2 and 3 and whether a giants defense sans brian burns can pressure jacoby brissett and co into critical errors at this point in the season i have more faith in the steady brissett and mike lafleur s overachieving cards team than a new york outfit making desperate september trades to stabilize a roster depleted of star power oh yeah and arizona doesn t lose at metlife math why gennaro picked the eagles last sunday night los angeles blew a 16 0 halftime lead at denver to drop back below 500 in a season that began with the rams as prohibitive super bowl favorites one night later philadelphia was blown out of chicago by a bears team that was forced to give case keenum his first start in 1 009 days so after a pair of nationally televised debacles who s in better position to bounce back well the expected return of star wr puka nacua is certainly a boon to sean mcvay s squad but can the rams coach exorcise his demons against the eagles mcvay is 1 6 vs philadelphia having dropped all four matchups against nick sirianni last season s loss at lincoln financial field was particularly painful not only did the rams blow a 19 point third quarter lead but they had two fourth quarter field goal attempts blocked including a would be game winner from 44 yards out on the last snap of the contest in addition to swatting that final kick hulking dt jordan davis memorably scooped up the ball and galloped for an exclamation point touchdown but the big man s triumphant rumble was easily the eagles best run of the day as the rams held saquon barkley to just 55 total yards on 22 touches that was a huge departure from barkley s previous two games against l a when he piled up 534 scrimmage yards philly s had trouble getting a consistent ground attack going under new oc sean mannion but barkley did enjoy success against chicago this past monday night before the game got out of hand potentially signaling a schematic breakthrough in a matchup between two established powers that have yet to play up to their talent level this season i m far from bullish on the eagles but i anticipate sirianni will rally the troops once again versus mcvay with the birds feeling disrespected as home underdogs why bobby picked the buccaneers once upon a time undrafted rookie tommy devito led the giants to a shocking upset over the packers rushing for 71 yards while throwing for another 158 and a touchdown that was against a 2023 version of green bay playing far better than a packers squad currently in full blown crisis mode with baker mayfield out several weeks due to a dislocated thumb undrafted rookie jalon daniels who impressed enough in preseason to win the backup job has a chance to pen a similar story daniels finding a way to spark tampa bay s struggling offense isn t as farfetched as it might seem that s not to say he s the quarterback mayfield is but baker currently sits dead last among qualified quarterbacks with a 35 6 expected points added per nfl pro the bar for daniels to surpass what the 2026 version of mayfield did through three games is not remotely high and everyone saw what michael penix achieved against the packers d during his first game back since tearing his acl on nov 16 last season green bay s thursday night debacle didn t portray its offense in any more of a positive light the offensive line is swiss cheese allowing the quickest average time to pressure 2 29 and struggling to forge a path for the league s worst rushing attack which has managed 146 yards in three games do the patchwork signings of mekhi becton laken tomlinson and kevin zeitler change that not nearly soon enough which could lead to the bucs first win of the season why bobby picked the vikings generally a good rule of thumb is to go with the 3 0 team over the 0 3 one minnesota would be the correct pick regardless of records though the vikings offense which currently sits last in the league in yards should be in line for a reprieve against a porous miami squad the fins rank 28th in points allowed through three weeks and their 0 15 expected points added per play allowed is tied with the colts for worst in the league per nfl pro there might be some concerns moving forward if kyler murray and the offense don t fully wake up against miami but it shouldn t affect this particular result that s because minnesota s dominant defense is set to feast on the dolphins struggling offense which just lost its best player de 39 von achane to a season ending acl tear miami has yet to score more than 13 points this season while the vikings are allowing an average of 13 7 brian flores will ensure the dolphins don t have an easy time trying to buck those trends the most daring defensive coordinator in the league boasts a blitz rate of 68 1 24 2 higher than the second most blitz happy team malik willis enters week 4 tied for the fourth worst completion percentage 50 against blitzes and now he must face the purple porpoise eaters i know dolphins aren t porpoises allow me the alliteration why brooke picked the raiders two of the five remaining undefeateds reside in the afc west and who thought the raiders would be one put your hand down they face their toughest opponent to date in the chiefs whose offense continues to steadily improve with eric bieniemy back as oc see a much improved run game led by the nfl s leading rusher kenneth walker with patrick mahomes leveling back up to his mvp caliber standards and whose defense is a top five overall and scoring unit i believe these raiders are up for the challenge kirk cousins is jibing with klint kubiak s scheme throwing three tds in each game this season and plays well against man coverage which steve spagnuolo s defense runs on 37 6 percent of dropbacks fifth most in the nfl per next gen stats cousins has six pass tds zero ints and a 126 2 passer rating vs man this season while recording three pass tds three ints and an 85 2 passer rating vs zone coverage cousins has time to deal with the way his o line is playing five sacks allowed through three games but the raiders need week 3 afc offensive player of the week brock bowers and ashton jeanty to show up in a big way las vegas leads the league with a 5 turnover differential and defensively the team is tied for fourth in sacks but the raiders must limit walker that s a huge key to this game this is the most inspiring the raiders have looked in eons and though the chiefs might be the more experienced of the two vegas newfound confidence and the energy the black hole will bring to allegiant stadium on sunday will be just enough to eke out a w giving the franchise more wins heading into week 5 than it managed in the entire 2025 season why bobby picked the seahawks the seahawks week 3 loss to the commanders was their first since nov 16 of 2025 when they square off against the chargers they will have suffered just two defeats in the previous 365 days it was shocking to see them falter against a formerly winless washington team led by backup quarterback marcus mariota but that s easy enough to wave away as any given sunday these chargers it s impossible to dismiss all that plagues them they re so offensively challenged that even with the bills turning it over five times they only managed 16 points in their recent loss to buffalo and that was the most los angeles has scored all season regardless of one takeaway filled day the chargers defense isn t performing up to its typical stellar standard the unit currently ranks 20th in points allowed down from ninth in 2025 and first in 2024 the struggles have even carried over to pro bowl kicker cameron dicker who has missed a field goal attempt in each of the last two outings the chargers will be desperate to turn it around sunday and start salvaging their season but the seahawks a much better team will also likely play with a little extra fire coming off such a jaw dropping loss why dan picked the 49ers i d like to see the broncos play a complete game before i predict them to go on the road and defeat the team that s arguably been the best in football through three weeks denver is 2 1 but it s been outscored 40 10 in the first halves of its first three games the concerningly slow starts are not lost on head coach sean payton who said this week that trying to play catch up will cost us in bigger games sunday s matchup feels like it could be one of those featuring two squads with legitimate super bowl aspirations the broncos have already proven they can come back against the league s better teams doing so at home versus the jaguars and rams in consecutive weeks but now they re the visitors against the undefeated 49ers who must be feeling pretty comfy as they prepare for their third consecutive game at levi s stadium a scheduling quirk for a club that opened the season in australia brock purdy is playing at an elite level even with injuries once again plaguing san francisco s receiving corps and kyle shanahan is on a coaching heater dating back to last season it won t come easy but i m expecting the niners to be 4 0 entering week 5 for the first time since 2023 why gennaro picked the lions three weeks into the season detroit ranks near the bottom of the nfl in most defensive categories fortunately the lions continue to field one of the league s most potent offenses having scored exactly 31 points in all three games how will the panthers look to counter defensively that s a good question after all ejiro evero s unit ranks dead last in run defense giving up a bountiful 5 7 yards per carry more than half a yard worse than any other team good luck containing jahmyr gibbs does carolina at least have the horses to keep up with amon ra st brown and jameson williams in the passing game not anymore star cb1 jaycee horn and underrated cb2 mike jackson just hit injured reserve now one thing that could help the panthers slow down the lions is the outdoor environment at bank of america stadium not only is detroit a dome team but at publishing it looks like this could be a rainy weekend in charlotte then again if precipitation ultimately plays a role on sunday night carolina might not be able to take full advantage of detroit s disastrous secondary the panthers should put some points on the board but i ll be surprised if they keep up with the lions posse of playmakers monday oct 5 why dan picked the saints new orleans is a few plays away from being 3 0 right now i can t say the same for the falcons although the rout of a lost green bay team in michael penix s 2026 debut was highly encouraging the saints have the smallest margin of defeat 4 5 among the 16 teams with multiple losses entering week 4 and they beat themselves last sunday turning the ball over on all four of their possessions in the fourth quarter against the raiders i m expecting a cleaner performance from tyler shough who ranks second in the league in passing yards 917 and is tied for third in touchdown passes 8 entering week 4 jeff ulbrich has atlanta s defense playing inspired ball even with injuries to key players but kellen moore s group should provide the stiffest test it s faced so far the superdome crowd always brings the energy and the vibes will likely be off the charts on monday night as the saints celebrate the 20th anniversary of one of the most iconic games in franchise history give me the home team in a tight one thursday s game why dan picked the steelers i know the recent history of the steelers trips to cleveland it s the stuff of nightmares for pittsburgh but i m not ready to trust the browns offense it ranks among the bottom five units in too many categories including total yards third down conversion rate and red zone touchdown percentage now i m certainly not convinced the steelers are a finely tuned offensive machine either even after their 30 point outburst against the bengals mike mccarthy s crew was held to three points in a loss less than two weeks ago so i m predicting a low scoring contest on thursday night if the browns defense led by second year breakout dt mason graham keeps aaron rodgers from ever getting comfortable the upset will be in play i saw too many poor throws from deshaun watson last week to forecast such an outcome though especially with injuries leaving cleveland vulnerable on the interior of the offensive line visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.description: Can Marcus Mariota thrive once again in relief of Jayden Daniels? Will Darren Waller go off against the Lions in prime time? Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 4.
news_mentions.body_text: pumpkin spice lattes scary movies and orange foliage as far as the eye can see they re all on the way it s october hard to believe we ve already completed a sixth of the nfl season it has been a wild first three weeks and they ve given way to a week 4 slate with some juicy matchups a potential international shootout a cat fight in cincinnati a battle for texas bragging rights and just as we all expected the showdown of unbeatens in las vegas for first place in the afc west there are plenty of fantasy points to be seized in such a schedule even from the most unlikely of places that s what the sleepers column is all about not all of us can have jahmyr gibbs jaxon smith njigba brock purdy and brock bowers on our rosters whether you re trying to stay unbeaten get back to 500 or notch that elusive first win of the season let s all have some fun and find some diamonds in the rough note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Commissioner Roger Goodell meets with Illinois governor as Bears continue pursuit of new stadium
news_mentions.description: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell met with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker and the leadership of the state's General Assembly on Thursday, adding another wrinkle to the Chicago Bears' long-running pursuit of a new home.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl commissioner roger goodell met with illinois gov jb pritzker and the leadership of the state s general assembly on thursday adding another wrinkle to the chicago bears long running pursuit of a new home the bears said in august that the franchise s sole focus for the construction of a new stadium and mixed use development was on hammond indiana but the public confirmation of the conversation between goodell and pritzker indicates that illinois remains in the mix the bears also had been considering arlington heights about 30 miles northwest of chicago as a potential location for an enclosed stadium illinois speaker emanuel chris welch state sen bill cunningham and state rep kam buckner joined pritzker at the meeting as the president pro tempore of the illinois senate cunningham frequently serves as the body s presiding officer and buckner s district includes soldier field the current home for the bears pat ryan a billionaire minority investor in the bears and a member of the team s board of directors also attended the governor s office has remained in conversation with the bears about their plans in illinois throughout the summer pritzker s office said in a statement the governor and general assembly leadership were glad to participate in a productive meeting focused on keeping the bears in illinois and protecting taxpayers the nfl said in a release that it appreciated the opportunity to meet with pritzker and the state legislators timely action is essential as the bears work to find a long term stadium solution for the club and their fans the league said a message was left by the associated press seeking comment from the team the bears a charter nfl franchise have played in illinois since the team s founding in 1920 as the decatur staleys they moved to chicago in 1921 and called wrigley field home before they started playing at soldier field in september 1971 the bears lease runs through 2033 but they can pay a fee to break the lease early soldier field is about 40 miles south of halas hall the team s headquarters in lake forest illinois and hammond is about 20 miles south of the team s lakefront stadium the bears ramped up their focus on indiana after a proposal to provide financial incentives for the team to build its new home in illinois stalled in the state legislature a committee in the indiana house of representatives passed a bill in february that established a northwest indiana stadium authority to finance construct and lease a stadium the illinois senate passed a bill that would have cleared the way for arlington heights and chicago to create local stadium authorities creating a pathway for the bears to avoid paying property taxes on a new stadium but the house adjourned without taking up the measure on the last day of the state s spring legislative session the bears have been pursuing a new home for years but the process has been hampered by repeated twists and turns the team announced in september 2021 that it had signed a purchase agreement for 326 acres of land in arlington heights the 197 million deal with churchill downs inc was finalized in 2023 in september 2022 the team unveiled a nearly 5 billion plan for arlington heights that called for an enclosed stadium that could host super bowls and final fours the conceptual illustrations also provided for a year round entertainment district with restaurants and shopping but the bears shifted their focus toward building a new stadium next to soldier field after kevin warren was hired as team president in january 2023 the plan to transform chicago s museum campus got an enthusiastic endorsement from mayor brandon johnson but a tepid reception from pritzker and state legislators when it was announced in april 2024 the team switched gears again in may 2025 announcing it had made significant progress with local leaders in arlington heights amid lingering efforts to secure tax incentives in illinois along with as much as 855 million in public money for infrastructure at the arlington heights site the bears began to take a closer look at possible options in northwest indiana warren said in august that the team was in regular almost daily communication with the state of indiana working on the project he called it an excellent deal a win win partnership together copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Jets' Aaron Glenn looking forward to facing Ben Johnson, Bears: 'He's a damn good coach'
news_mentions.description: Jets HC Aaron Glenn is set to face a familiar foe for the second straight week when his team takes on Ben Johnson's Bears.
news_mentions.body_text: aaron glenn is on an unintentional reunion tour in weeks 3 and 4 the former lions defensive coordinator returned to detroit with his new york jets last week falling 31 24 to dan campbell and co this sunday glenn s jets will face former lions offensive coordinator ben johnson s chicago bears whom glenn knows quite well from their many practices spent battling against each other in detroit we were so competitive in move the ball situations on how we wanted to beat each other but it made both of us better i will say that glenn said wednesday about going up against johnson during lions practices via the jets official site he s a damn good coach those practices were famously competitive the 2022 season of hbo s hard knocks featured the lions which meant the up close look at the up and coming team would undoubtedly include some footage of these sessions and glenn and running backs coach duce staley didn t disappoint in their trash talk given how the lions transformed into a perennial contender in the ensuing seasons it s no surprise campbell s lieutenants have taken top jobs elsewhere one of these two is a step ahead of the other as of now though johnson has a 2025 division title and playoff win on his resume as bears coach while glenn is still working toward transforming the jets when you have coordinators offensive and defensive coordinators you re really planning practice glenn said you re really planning the things you want to see against each other so the communication between me and him was always outstanding just talking offensive and defensive football was good to have this portion of the jets 2026 schedule is either a coincidence or a cruel joke the connections don t stop here either new york faces the cleveland browns for whom staley serves as running backs coach in week 5 it s also serving as a quality test of glenn s jets and where they stand in their second year under his direction observers will note new york has played much more competitively through three weeks than they did at almost any point in the 2025 season and if glenn needed his own measuring stick he s receiving two in consecutive weeks he ll have his hands full this week johnson s bears aren t expected to have budding star quarterback caleb williams available due to a hamstring injury suffered in week 2 but after 38 year old third stringer case keenum carved up the philadelphia eagles on monday night glenn s jets might have to prepare for any of chicago s three quarterbacks adding more work to his plate glenn isn t going to back down though much like the heated sessions on the practice fields in michigan he ll bring his full effort primarily because he knows it s required johnson has those guys playing really really well glenn said we re looking forward to having a good week of practice and getting ready to go compete against a really good team our guys will be ready to do that

news_mentions.description: When spending his summer preparing for the 2026 season, Bears coach Ben Johnson probably didn't anticipate a quarterback conundrum.
news_mentions.body_text: when spending his summer preparing for the 2026 season bears coach ben johnson probably didn t anticipate a quarterback conundrum that s not exactly what s happening in chicago right now either but johnson spent his wednesday fielding questions regarding who will start under center for him in week 4 against the visiting jets unsurprisingly he didn t provide a firm answer we ve got three guys johnson said via the team s official site we ll work through the week and see where they re at logic and recent events would lead one to expect johnson to continue with 38 year old case keenum the 14 year veteran who propelled the bears to a 20 point win over the eagles on monday night by completing 24 of 34 passes for 247 yards and two touchdowns it s not quite that simple though keenum is listed as chicago s third string quarterback behind younger backup tyson bagent and madden nfl 27 cover star caleb williams whose week 2 hamstring injury threw the bears into uncertainty keenum was initially an afterthought too until it was revealed bagent had suffered a concussion in the week 2 loss to minnesota and was in concussion protocol keenum responded as any capable experienced veteran would stepping into the role and giving his best effort it produced stunning results helping the bears to a dominant victory and settling the concerns regarding chicago s situation under center for a week that doesn t mean johnson is necessarily going to ride the hot hand though we re looking at everything johnson said he played really well the other night sure that plays a part of the evaluation johnson has a game for which he must plan of course and determining who is handling the snaps is an important part of the process he s already completed that process the coach said wednesday he just isn t revealing who he s selected instead he s keeping that secret as a competitive advantage in the meantime folks outside halas hall can spend the week reviewing what s occurred and conclude it s especially helpful to have three competent quarterbacks on a roster johnson would agree it s not hard for me at all he said i feel really good about all three quarterbacks in that room and i know all three of them can win ballgames for us
